game_matches.translation: "让我猜猜，你想让我帮你挖这位男爵的坟。"

units.source: The man grins, a pathetic sight, one that reminds you of the time you scolded a dog for stealing a biscuit.
units.zh: 那人咧嘴一笑，模样可怜巴巴，让你想起从前训斥一条偷饼干的狗时，它露出的神情。

game_matches.translation: 那人咧嘴一笑，模样可怜巴巴，让你想起从前训斥一条偷饼干的狗时，它露出的神情。

units.source: {#1}{#2}I'm not going to, and neither are you.{/#2}{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 我不去，你也别想去。

units.source: The graverobber quickly looks behind himself, then says again, his voice a bit quieter this time.
units.zh: 盗墓贼迅速回头张望，又压低声音说了一遍。

game_matches.translation: 盗墓贼迅速回头张望，又压低声音说了一遍。

units.source: "I got it... I got all of it. Look, I'll split it with you. I mean, you didn't help me avoid the watchman, or shovel up the earth, or drag the body out, or drag the chest out, or put the coffin back in its place, or put the dirt back on the coffin, or avoid the watchman a second time, or drag the chest all the way into camp... but you did let me do it!"
units.zh: "到手了……全到手了。您看，我跟您分。虽说您没帮我躲守夜人，没帮我挖土，没帮我拖尸体，也没帮我搬箱子、把棺材放回原处、把土填回去、再躲一次守夜人，或者把箱子一路拖回营地……不过，您准许我去干了呀！"

game_matches.translation: "到手了……全到手了。您看，我跟您分。虽说您没帮我躲守夜人，没帮我挖土，没帮我拖尸体，也没帮我搬箱子、把棺材放回原处、把土填回去、再躲一次守夜人，或者把箱子一路拖回营地……不过，您准许我去干了呀！"

units.source: The man quickly raises a finger, a slop of mud flying waywardly into nowhere but a wet sound.
units.zh: 他赶紧竖起一根手指，一团稀泥随之甩飞，不知落到哪儿，只听见湿漉漉的一声。

game_matches.translation: 他赶紧竖起一根手指，一团稀泥随之甩飞，不知落到哪儿，只听见湿漉漉的一声。

units.source: You stop the man with a raised hand.
units.zh: 你抬手打断他。

game_matches.translation: 你抬手打断他。

units.source: "How about you go get patched up and then we'll talk about this 'next time', yeah?"
units.zh: "先去包扎一下，再来谈你这个“下次”，怎么样？"

game_matches.translation: "先去包扎一下，再来谈你这个“下次”，怎么样？"

units.source: "Well... alright then... I suppose it was only riches..."
units.zh: "那……好吧……反正也不过是些财宝……"

game_matches.translation: "那……好吧……反正也不过是些财宝……"

units.source: About the graveyard are rows and rows of gray slabs and marbled statues with no faces and black iron gates that hee-hawed in the wind. Tall grass everywhere, fertilizer in abundance. Flowers homegrown and others laid down from elsewhere, and some a bit of both.
units.zh: 墓园里，一排排灰色石碑、没有面孔的大理石雕像和漆黑铁门错落分布，铁门在风中发出驴叫般的怪响。高草四处丛生，肥料想必是不缺的。花有自己长出来的，也有别人从外面带来的，还有些两者兼有。

game_matches.translation: 墓园里，一排排灰色石碑、没有面孔的大理石雕像和漆黑铁门错落分布，铁门在风中发出驴叫般的怪响。高草四处丛生，肥料想必是不缺的。花有自己长出来的，也有别人从外面带来的，还有些两者兼有。
墓园里，一排排灰色石碑、没有面孔的大理石雕像和漆黑铁门错落分布，铁门在风中发出驴叫般的怪响。高草四处丛生，肥料想必是不缺的。花有自己长出来的，也有别人从外面带来的，还有些两者兼有。

units.source: Pursing his lips, the graverobber turns about. He stabs his shovel into the ground and puts his fists to his hips.
units.zh: 盗墓贼抿着嘴，转了一圈，将铲子插进土里，双拳叉腰。

game_matches.translation: 盗墓贼抿着嘴，转了一圈，将铲子插进土里，双拳叉腰。

units.source: Sensing something off, you ask what's wrong. He spits and answers.
units.zh: 你察觉不对，问怎么了。他啐了一口，答道。

game_matches.translation: 你察觉不对，问怎么了。他啐了一口，答道。

units.source: "I can't 'member if it is that grave, that one, or that one."
units.zh: "我记不清是那座坟，还是那座，还是那座了。"

game_matches.translation: "我记不清是那座坟，还是那座，还是那座了。"

units.source: He points to three different sites: one is a modest little stone, bleached and balded to commemorate a death; another is gated with gothic spires; another is but a door to a mausoleum. The graverobber turns to you.
units.zh: 他接连指向三处：一处只有块朴素的小石碑，被风雨磨得发白光秃，记着一个人的死；一处围着尖顶铁门；另一处则只露出陵墓的入口。盗墓贼转向你。

game_matches.translation: 他接连指向三处：一处只有块朴素的小石碑，被风雨磨得发白光秃，记着一个人的死；一处围着尖顶铁门；另一处则只露出陵墓的入口。盗墓贼转向你。

units.source: "We probably don't have much time here, which grave you think it be?"
units.zh: "咱们在这儿恐怕待不了太久。你觉得是哪座？"

game_matches.translation: "咱们在这儿恐怕待不了太久。你觉得是哪座？"

units.source: You nod. The graverobber glances from dead man to living.
units.zh: 你点头。盗墓贼的目光从死人移到活人身上。

game_matches.translation: 你点头。盗墓贼的目光从死人移到活人身上。

units.source: "Suppose... this knight don't need that stuff no more..."
units.zh: "看来……这位骑士也用不上这些东西了……"

game_matches.translation: "看来……这位骑士也用不上这些东西了……"

units.source: Suddenly, voices rise up from outside the graveyard. You grab all the things you can and tell the graverobber to start running.
units.zh: 这时，墓地外突然响起人声。你抓起尽可能多的东西，叫盗墓贼赶紧跑。

game_matches.translation: 这时，墓地外突然响起人声。你抓起尽可能多的东西，叫盗墓贼赶紧跑。

units.source: Just as you take your shovel into hand, a man's voice calls out to you.
units.zh: 你刚把铲子拿到手里，就听见一个男人冲你们喊道。

game_matches.translation: 你刚把铲子拿到手里，就听见一个男人冲你们喊道。

units.source: "Just what in the hell do you think y'all are doing?"
units.zh: "你们他娘的想干什么？"

game_matches.translation: "你们他娘的想干什么？"

units.source: You wheel around to see a man lighting a lantern. He holds it up, the handle creaking as it swivels back and forth.
units.zh: 你猛地转身，看见一个男人点亮了提灯。他将灯举起，灯身前后摇晃，把手吱呀作响。

game_matches.translation: 你猛地转身，看见一个男人点亮了提灯。他将灯举起，灯身前后摇晃，把手吱呀作响。

units.source: "Come after me ye may, but not before I give this here bell a good ringing. Then the next bell you'll hear shall toll for thee."
units.zh: "尽管来追我，可在那之前，我准能把这铃铛摇个痛快。到时候，你们再听到的，可就是给自己送葬的丧钟了。"

game_matches.translation: "尽管来追我，可在那之前，我准能把这铃铛摇个痛快。到时候，你们再听到的，可就是给自己送葬的丧钟了。"

units.source: "I'll remember yer faces! Like a kicked dog knows the boot that done did it, I'll remember yer faces!"
units.zh: "我记住你们的脸了！就像挨踢的狗认得那只靴子一样，我记住你们的脸了！"

game_matches.translation: "我记住你们的脸了！就像挨踢的狗认得那只靴子一样，我记住你们的脸了！"

units.source: The gravedigger climbs on top of the graverobber and starts piling mud into his opponent's face.
units.zh: 掘墓人骑到盗墓贼身上，抓起泥巴往他脸上糊。

game_matches.translation: 掘墓人骑到盗墓贼身上，抓起泥巴往他脸上糊。

units.source: "What'd I tell ya, huh? What'd I say about thievin' from those who can't see your grimy little hands comin', huh?"
units.zh: "我跟你说过什么，嗯？那些人连你伸来的脏手都看不见，别偷他们的东西！我是不是这么说的，嗯？"

game_matches.translation: "我跟你说过什么，嗯？那些人连你伸来的脏手都看不见，别偷他们的东西！我是不是这么说的，嗯？"

units.source: With a nice little reversal that suggests this isn't his first time wrestling in the mud, the graverobber throws his assailant off and clambers atop him. He grabs great big piles of grass and grime and shoves it into the gravedigger's face. Bizarrely, the graverobber thinks it's time to make his case.
units.zh: 盗墓贼一个漂亮的翻身，把对手掀了下来，反骑到他身上，熟练得显然不是头一回在泥地里摔跤。他抓起大把草叶和污泥，往掘墓人脸上塞。奇怪的是，他竟觉得这会儿正适合讲道理。

game_matches.translation: 盗墓贼一个漂亮的翻身，把对手掀了下来，反骑到他身上，熟练得显然不是头一回在泥地里摔跤。他抓起大把草叶和污泥，往掘墓人脸上塞。奇怪的是，他竟觉得这会儿正适合讲道理。

units.source: "It only be his shoes! It only be his gloves! Dead needn't be walkin' or pickin' things up, let 'em be mine I say!"
units.zh: "不就是双鞋嘛！不就是副手套嘛！死人又不用走路，也不用拿东西，给我用怎么了！"

game_matches.translation: "不就是双鞋嘛！不就是副手套嘛！死人又不用走路，也不用拿东西，给我用怎么了！"

units.source: Ah, it appears that the gravedigger and graverobber have come across a mild difference on what goes into the ground and what shant come back out. You let them work through their troubles - there is little harm to be done between the two of them and it is making good entertainment for the rest of the company, anyway.
units.zh: 啊，看来这两位对什么该埋进土里、什么不该再拿出来，存在一点小小的分歧。你让他们自行解决——两人也伤不到哪去，何况还给其他弟兄添了不少乐子。

game_matches.translation: 啊，看来这两位对什么该埋进土里、什么不该再拿出来，存在一点小小的分歧。你让他们自行解决——两人也伤不到哪去，何况还给其他弟兄添了不少乐子。

units.source: While you attempt to study some poorly drawn maps, the sound of blades being drawn pierces your ears. You roll up your work and put it into a scroll's sleeve before making way to the disturbance.
units.zh: 你正努力研究几张画得蹩脚的地图，刀剑出鞘的声音突然传进耳中。你卷好地图，收进卷筒，前去查看动静。

game_matches.translation: 你正努力研究几张画得蹩脚的地图，刀剑出鞘的声音突然传进耳中。你卷好地图，收进卷筒，前去查看动静。

units.source: While you try to bring peace between a party of misfits, your attempts for neutrality only seem to anger a few of the men. In particular, the man with the nicked neck is seething, swearing and kicking things over. A few of the other men worry aloud about a lack of discipline.
units.zh: 你试着让这群难缠的家伙和睦相处，可保持中立的做法似乎只惹怒了几个人。尤其脖子被划伤的那个，气得破口大骂，踢翻东西。另一些弟兄则公开担忧起战团的纪律。

game_matches.translation: 你试着让这群难缠的家伙和睦相处，可保持中立的做法似乎只惹怒了几个人。尤其脖子被划伤的那个，气得破口大骂，踢翻东西。另一些弟兄则公开担忧起战团的纪律。

units.source: Riders crest a nearby hill, their silhouettes dark and oddly shaped on its rim like a reef of rippling black. Not wholly able to see who they are, you order a few of your brothers to hide away. An ambush might be needed to defend yourself otherwise you stand no chance against such a mounted force. As the selected mercenaries dip into the bushes, the horsemen begin heading down the hill. The thunder of the hooves grows louder, but you stand resolute, hoping to give your men a good show of bravery.
units.zh: 一队骑手登上附近山丘，轮廓沿山脊铺开，漆黑而形状古怪，像一道起伏的黑色暗礁。还看不清来者身份，你便叫几个弟兄藏起来。面对这样的骑兵，正面毫无胜算，也许只能靠伏击自保。被点中的佣兵钻进灌木时，骑手们开始下坡。蹄声如雷，越来越响，你却站定不动，希望给弟兄们做个勇敢的榜样。

game_matches.translation: 一队骑手登上附近山丘，轮廓沿山脊铺开，漆黑而形状古怪，像一道起伏的黑色暗礁。还看不清来者身份，你便叫几个弟兄藏起来。面对这样的骑兵，正面毫无胜算，也许只能靠伏击自保。被点中的佣兵钻进灌木时，骑手们开始下坡。蹄声如雷，越来越响，你却站定不动，希望给弟兄们做个勇敢的榜样。
一队骑手登上附近山丘，轮廓沿山脊铺开，漆黑而形状古怪，像一道起伏的黑色暗礁。还看不清来者身份，你便叫几个弟兄藏起来。面对这样的骑兵，正面毫无胜算，也许只能靠伏击自保。被点中的佣兵钻进灌木时，骑手们开始下坡。蹄声如雷，越来越响，你却站定不动，希望给弟兄们做个勇敢的榜样。

units.source: You turn your head and spit. You nod at the lawman before asking him a question.
units.zh: 你侧头啐了一口，朝执法者点点头，反问道。

game_matches.translation: 你侧头啐了一口，朝执法者点点头，反问道。

units.source: "And whose authority do you have? There are a lot of lords in these lands and not all of them pay me well."
units.zh: "你奉的是谁的命？这片土地上的领主多得很，可不是个个都肯给我好价钱。"

game_matches.translation: "你奉的是谁的命？这片土地上的领主多得很，可不是个个都肯给我好价钱。"

units.source: The lawmen's captain sits back down in his saddle. His hands cross over his pommel, resting there with armored authority. He does not look the least bit amused and voices his displeasure as such.
units.zh: 执法队长重新坐回鞍中，戴甲的双手交叠在鞍桥上，摆出十足威势。他丝毫不觉得好笑，开口便表露不满。

game_matches.translation: 执法队长重新坐回鞍中，戴甲的双手交叠在鞍桥上，摆出十足威势。他丝毫不觉得好笑，开口便表露不满。

units.source: "The punishment for willfully harboring a fugitive is death. You've but one more chance to release this criminal to me or you shall face a fate well suited for a sword-selling dog."
units.zh: "蓄意窝藏逃犯，处以死刑。你只剩最后一次机会，把罪犯交给我，否则就去领受你这条卖命野狗应得的下场。"

game_matches.translation: "蓄意窝藏逃犯，处以死刑。你只剩最后一次机会，把罪犯交给我，否则就去领受你这条卖命野狗应得的下场。"

units.source: {#1}{#2}The company would only suffer if we fought over this. The man is yours.{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}{#2}为这事动手只会害了战团。人归你们。{/#2}{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 为这事动手只会害了战团。人归你们。

units.source: Instead, you lean over and pick up the coins, swallow you pride, and say your thanks. The lawmen waste little time returning from whence they came.
units.zh: 于是，你俯身捡起钱袋，咽下这口气，道了声谢。执法队没多耽搁，沿来路返回了。

game_matches.translation: 于是，你俯身捡起钱袋，咽下这口气，道了声谢。执法队没多耽搁，沿来路返回了。

units.source: As the lawman stares at you, waiting for an answer, you let out a sharp whistle. Half of the company emerges from the bushes, whooping and hollering in ambush. The steed pulling the travois bucks its rider to the ground before taking off altogether, a group of wide-eyed criminals going along for the ride. Another lawman retreats, abandoning his troop.
units.zh: 执法者盯着你，等你答话，你却吹了声尖锐的口哨。半个战团从灌木丛中跃出，呼喝着发动伏击。拉着拖架的马把骑手掀下地，狂奔而去，带着一群目瞪口呆的囚犯颠簸逃远。另一个执法者则抛下同伴，独自退走。

game_matches.translation: 执法者盯着你，等你答话，你却吹了声尖锐的口哨。半个战团从灌木丛中跃出，呼喝着发动伏击。拉着拖架的马把骑手掀下地，狂奔而去，带着一群目瞪口呆的囚犯颠簸逃远。另一个执法者则抛下同伴，独自退走。

units.source: The rest of his men come to stand by his body and they look to you with vengeance in their eyes.
units.zh: 剩下的手下站到尸体旁，望向你，眼中满是复仇的怒火。

game_matches.translation: 剩下的手下站到尸体旁，望向你，眼中满是复仇的怒火。

units.source: The brother looks at you, and then the lawmen. He nods.
units.zh: 这位弟兄看了看你，又看了看执法队，点头。

game_matches.translation: 这位弟兄看了看你，又看了看执法队，点头。

units.source: "That I did. He had a mouthful of my bread when I stuck him like a pig! I saved the rest of the loaf for m'self, thank goodness."
units.zh: "没错，是我干的。我像杀猪一样捅进去时，他嘴里还塞着我的面包！谢天谢地，剩下的面包我还给自己保住了。"

game_matches.translation: "没错，是我干的。我像杀猪一样捅进去时，他嘴里还塞着我的面包！谢天谢地，剩下的面包我还给自己保住了。"

units.source: The lawmen chuckle amongst themselves. Their captain looks back on them, his gaze a quieting one. He looks back to you. You can see why they shut up: his eyes are stern, unmoving, fierce, black. The man holds you in this stare for nearly half a minute before he nods and gathers his reins.
units.zh: 执法队员们笑了起来。队长回头看了他们一眼，众人随即安静下来。他又转向你。你明白他们为何噤声了：那双漆黑的眼睛严厉、凶狠，目光纹丝不动。他这样盯了你近半分钟，才点头收拢缰绳。

game_matches.translation: 执法队员们笑了起来。队长回头看了他们一眼，众人随即安静下来。他又转向你。你明白他们为何噤声了：那双漆黑的眼睛严厉、凶狠，目光纹丝不动。他这样盯了你近半分钟，才点头收拢缰绳。

units.source: "Alright, mercenary. Thank you for letting us know."
units.zh: "好吧，佣兵。多谢告知。"

game_matches.translation: "好吧，佣兵。多谢告知。"

units.source: The lawmen pack up and head back from whence they came. A sigh of relief passes over the company as a whole and you order the men hiding in the bushes to come out. It's a long road ahead and hopefully there won't be more problems like this one.
units.zh: 执法队收拾妥当，沿来路离去。整个战团都松了一口气。你叫藏在灌木中的弟兄出来。前路还长，但愿别再遇上这样的麻烦。

game_matches.translation: 执法队收拾妥当，沿来路离去。整个战团都松了一口气。你叫藏在灌木中的弟兄出来。前路还长，但愿别再遇上这样的麻烦。

units.source: "Is this the man you are after? I can see why you might think this is him, but look at these scars. The man in the drawing has none. And look at his hair! The one in the drawing is straight, and this man's is clearly matted and curly."
units.zh: "这是你们要找的人？我能理解你为什么觉得像，可看看这些疤，画里的人可没有。再看头发！画上是直的，这人却明摆着又乱又卷。"

game_matches.translation: "这是你们要找的人？我能理解你为什么觉得像，可看看这些疤，画里的人可没有。再看头发！画上是直的，这人却明摆着又乱又卷。"

units.source: You stop because judging by the faces of your audience this isn't even coming close to working. The captain draws his sword.
units.zh: 你停了下来，因为从听众的脸色看，这番话根本没起半点作用。队长拔剑。

game_matches.translation: 你停了下来，因为从听众的脸色看，这番话根本没起半点作用。队长拔剑。

units.source: "Do you take me for a fool? Kill them all."
units.zh: "你当我是傻子？全杀了。"

game_matches.translation: "你当我是傻子？全杀了。"

units.source: Well, so much for that. Before the lawmen can charge you whistle as loud as you can. Half the company surges forth from the bushes, whooping and hollering like banshees. The sudden fright drives the horses wild, pitching their riders into the dirt and the travois-puller even runs off altogether, carrying with it a couple of very confused criminals.
units.zh: 好吧，这招到此为止。执法队尚未冲锋，你已使出全力吹了一声口哨。半个战团从灌木中涌出，像报丧女妖般尖叫呼喊。突如其来的惊吓令马匹发狂，把骑手掀进泥里；拖曳架前的那匹马甚至径直逃走，还拖着几个一头雾水的囚犯。

game_matches.translation: 好吧，这招到此为止。执法队尚未冲锋，你已使出全力吹了一声口哨。半个战团从灌木中涌出，像报丧女妖般尖叫呼喊。突如其来的惊吓令马匹发狂，把骑手掀进泥里；拖曳架前的那匹马甚至径直逃走，还拖着几个一头雾水的囚犯。

units.source: The captain's threats are cooled when you retrieve a large satchel of crowns. His men exchange glances as you hold the bag up.
units.zh: 你拿出一大袋克朗，队长的威胁便缓了下来。你举起钱袋，他手下的人交换着眼神。

game_matches.translation: 你拿出一大袋克朗，队长的威胁便缓了下来。你举起钱袋，他手下的人交换着眼神。

units.source: Sensing the stares of his fellow riders, the captain is especially careful in mulling this one over. He sizes up your men, and briefly does the same to his men. He must see great losses for he finally nods. Jerking his horse's bridle, he drives his steed forward and the two of you come face to face. You smile as you hand the crowns over.
units.zh: 察觉同伴们都在看着自己，队长格外谨慎地权衡起来。他打量你的弟兄，又匆匆看了看自己的人。想必看出了硬拼必然死伤惨重，终于点了头。他一扯缰绳，策马上前，与你面对面。你微笑着递出钱袋。

game_matches.translation: 察觉同伴们都在看着自己，队长格外谨慎地权衡起来。他打量你的弟兄，又匆匆看了看自己的人。想必看出了硬拼必然死伤惨重，终于点了头。他一扯缰绳，策马上前，与你面对面。你微笑着递出钱袋。

units.source: The captain takes the satchel and cinches it to the side of his saddle, looping the leather harness over the hilt of a sword while his men look on. He nods, but does not smile back.
units.zh: 队长接过钱，在手下的注视中，将钱袋系到马鞍侧面，又把皮带绕过剑柄。他点了点头，却没回以笑容。

game_matches.translation: 队长接过钱，在手下的注视中，将钱袋系到马鞍侧面，又把皮带绕过剑柄。他点了点头，却没回以笑容。

units.source: "My daughter is to be wed in a fortnight. I'd like to be there."
units.zh: "我女儿两星期后成婚。我想亲眼看着。"

game_matches.translation: "我女儿两星期后成婚。我想亲眼看着。"

units.source: You nod and bid the humorless captain farewell.
units.zh: 你点头，与这位不苟言笑的队长道别。

game_matches.translation: 你点头，与这位不苟言笑的队长道别。

units.source: "May her husband be kind, and her children bountiful."
units.zh: "愿她嫁得良人，儿孙满堂。"

game_matches.translation: "愿她嫁得良人，儿孙满堂。"

units.source: The captain haws his horse and leads it back to his men. They depart, the hooves of their mounts steadily thumping into the distance until there is nothing but the scratch of wind-tickled grass to fill the air.
units.zh: 队长吆喝一声，拨马回到手下身边。他们离开了，马蹄声有节奏地渐行渐远，最后，空气里只剩风拂草叶的沙沙声。

game_matches.translation: 队长吆喝一声，拨马回到手下身边。他们离开了，马蹄声有节奏地渐行渐远，最后，空气里只剩风拂草叶的沙沙声。

units.source: The captain tells them that you're full of shit and to charge, but none follow his orders. Eventually, the captain is forced to turn back, heading after his men who are now in retreat.
units.zh: 队长骂你满嘴胡话，命令他们冲锋，可没人听从。最终，他也只得调头，追上已经撤退的手下。

game_matches.translation: 队长骂你满嘴胡话，命令他们冲锋，可没人听从。最终，他也只得调头，追上已经撤退的手下。
队长骂你满嘴胡话，命令他们冲锋，可没人听从。最终，他也只得调头，追上已经撤退的手下。

units.source: The supposed cannibal-brother walks up, scratching his head.
units.zh: 传闻中吃人的那位弟兄挠着头走来。

game_matches.translation: 传闻中吃人的那位弟兄挠着头走来。

units.source: A crackle of laughter rips through the company and soon a chant of 'don't eat me!' is to be had.
units.zh: 战团里爆发出一阵大笑，不一会儿，众人便齐声喊起“别吃我！”。

game_matches.translation: 战团里爆发出一阵大笑，不一会儿，众人便齐声喊起“别吃我！”。

units.source: "Hmm, what was the hardest to break into? Well, vaults were the easiest, let's get that out of the way first. I once stole so much from a vault that they tried to hang the locksmith for being so easily defeated by a common thief. They couldn't find the locksmith, for you see I'm no common thief, for the locksmith was me. Ha-ha! To answer your question, a tower is the hardest to break into, especially a tower standing alone."
units.zh: "嗯，什么地方最难潜进去？先说好，金库最容易。我有一回从金库偷走太多东西，他们居然想吊死锁匠，怪他的锁轻易就被普通小偷撬开。可他们找不着锁匠，因为我不是普通小偷——锁匠就是我。哈哈！说回你的问题，塔楼最难进，尤其是孤零零立着的一座塔。"

game_matches.translation: "嗯，什么地方最难潜进去？先说好，金库最容易。我有一回从金库偷走太多东西，他们居然想吊死锁匠，怪他的锁轻易就被普通小偷撬开。可他们找不着锁匠，因为我不是普通小偷——锁匠就是我。哈哈！说回你的问题，塔楼最难进，尤其是孤零零立着的一座塔。"

units.source: Sitting back on his laurels, the mason nods.
units.zh: 石匠颇为自得，点了点头。

game_matches.translation: 石匠颇为自得，点了点头。

units.source: "Aye, thought you might say so. Towers be built for prisoners of import or items of peculiar fancy. Little more than cages in the sky for creatures with no wings. But one time, a prisoner, some notorious fish thief, did manage an escape. He spent years upon years pulling out strands of his own hair and tying them together until the 'rope' was long enough for him to throw it out and climb down. They caught him a day later, unfortunately. He did the same trick again a few years later, but that time he roped it half-as-long and simply hanged himself instead."
units.zh: "是啊，就知道你会这么说。塔楼是用来关押要犯，或存放稀罕物件的。说白了，就是给没翅膀的东西造的空中牢笼。不过，有次一个囚犯逃了出来，是个臭名昭著的偷鱼贼。他花了好多年，一根根拔下自己的头发，接成长绳，直到够长，才扔到塔外，顺着爬了下去。可惜，隔天就被抓回来了。几年后，他又来这招，不过这回只搓了上次一半长，直接把自己吊死了。"

game_matches.translation: "是啊，就知道你会这么说。塔楼是用来关押要犯，或存放稀罕物件的。说白了，就是给没翅膀的东西造的空中牢笼。不过，有次一个囚犯逃了出来，是个臭名昭著的偷鱼贼。他花了好多年，一根根拔下自己的头发，接成长绳，直到够长，才扔到塔外，顺着爬了下去。可惜，隔天就被抓回来了。几年后，他又来这招，不过这回只搓了上次一半长，直接把自己吊死了。"

units.source: "That's interesting and all, but I'm a true thief, mason, not a mere robber of fishmongers. My question is how do I get -into- the tower."
units.zh: "这故事是挺有意思，可我是正经盗贼，石匠，不是什么抢鱼贩的小毛贼。我问的是，怎么进塔里去。"

game_matches.translation: "这故事是挺有意思，可我是正经盗贼，石匠，不是什么抢鱼贩的小毛贼。我问的是，怎么进塔里去。"

units.source: "Lemme tell you about my first delivery. I walked up to this keep that had a nice, beautiful moat. Most dangerous thing in the waters were lily pads and fly-fattened frogs. Walked right over the drawbridge and stepped inside, letter in hand, my belly turning with excitement. I get in there and what do I hear? Roo-roo-roo-roo! Ruh-ruh-ruh! This farkin' mongrel comes barreling out of its doghouse, teeth bared, ears pinned. I'm like oh shite, I didn't sign up for this and climb a chicken coop while this furred beast tries and eats me feet. Eventually, the lord comes out and the dog sits as though it'd done nothing at all. The nobleman laughs and takes the letter I came to deliver. He says, 'what, you didn't see the sign?' I said, uh no sir, but I'll be going now. When I left, they drew that drawbridge back up and wouldn't you know it, on the underside they'd painted this big 'Beware of Dog' warning!"
units.zh: "我跟你说说头一回送信吧。我走到一座城堡前，护城河漂亮得很，水里最危险的东西，也就是睡莲叶子和吃苍蝇吃肥了的青蛙。我径直过了吊桥，拿着信走进去，兴奋得肚子直翻。刚一进去，你猜我听见什么？汪汪汪汪！嗷嗷嗷！一条该死的杂毛狗从狗窝里冲出来，龇着牙，耳朵紧贴脑袋。我心想，坏了，我可没答应干这种活，赶紧爬上鸡舍，那毛畜生还在下面想啃我的脚。后来领主出来了，狗立刻坐下，像什么也没干过。贵族笑着接过信，问：“怎么，没看见告示？”我说，呃，没有，长官，不过我这就走。等我出去，他们把吊桥拉起来，你猜怎么着？桥底下写着老大几个字：“小心恶犬”！"

game_matches.translation: "我跟你说说头一回送信吧。我走到一座城堡前，护城河漂亮得很，水里最危险的东西，也就是睡莲叶子和吃苍蝇吃肥了的青蛙。我径直过了吊桥，拿着信走进去，兴奋得肚子直翻。刚一进去，你猜我听见什么？汪汪汪汪！嗷嗷嗷！一条该死的杂毛狗从狗窝里冲出来，龇着牙，耳朵紧贴脑袋。我心想，坏了，我可没答应干这种活，赶紧爬上鸡舍，那毛畜生还在下面想啃我的脚。后来领主出来了，狗立刻坐下，像什么也没干过。贵族笑着接过信，问：“怎么，没看见告示？”我说，呃，没有，长官，不过我这就走。等我出去，他们把吊桥拉起来，你猜怎么着？桥底下写着老大几个字：“小心恶犬”！"

units.source: "It's like we're on top of the world! Isn't this wonderful?"
units.zh: "咱们简直站在世界之巅！多美妙啊，不是吗？"

game_matches.translation: "咱们简直站在世界之巅！多美妙啊，不是吗？"

units.source: He can hardly breathe for shit, but the miner is too happy to care. Years of digging deep into the earth has made this reversal of perspective all the more wonderful.
units.zh: 他明明已经喘得够呛，却高兴得完全顾不上。多年埋头地底挖掘之后，如今换个方向看世界，对他而言便格外美妙。

game_matches.translation: 他明明已经喘得够呛，却高兴得完全顾不上。多年埋头地底挖掘之后，如今换个方向看世界，对他而言便格外美妙。

units.source: "Yo, yee man of such fleeting feet, feet that flee before you've been beat! The deserter! Oh, the deserter! A dessert for the deserter! His courage he did curdle, his honor he did hurdle, his manliness he did murder! The deserter!"
units.zh: "嘿，你这双腿倒得巧，还没挨打先开跑！逃兵呀，逃兵！赏你甜点压压惊！胆气早已馊，荣誉甩身后，男儿气概亲手丢！逃兵呀，逃兵！"

game_matches.translation: "嘿，你这双腿倒得巧，还没挨打先开跑！逃兵呀，逃兵！赏你甜点压压惊！胆气早已馊，荣誉甩身后，男儿气概亲手丢！逃兵呀，逃兵！"

units.source: "I... -strum- joined a band of mercenaries, my coffers all gone... -strum-... they wanted a fighter, but all I had were songs. The end."
units.zh: "我……——拨弦——钱袋空空，投身佣兵一帮……——拨弦——他们要的是战士，我却只会歌唱。完。"

game_matches.translation: "我……——拨弦——钱袋空空，投身佣兵一帮……——拨弦——他们要的是战士，我却只会歌唱。完。"

units.source: "Aye, you are some of the finest men I've ever met. I say that because I never knew my father and I spent all my years with the womenfolk."
units.zh: "诸位，你们是我见过最出色的一批男人。这么说，是因为我从没见过亲爹，这辈子又一直跟女人混。"

game_matches.translation: "诸位，你们是我见过最出色的一批男人。这么说，是因为我从没见过亲爹，这辈子又一直跟女人混。"

units.source: "Damn, have I been with a lot of women."
units.zh: "娘的，我可真跟过不少女人。"

game_matches.translation: "娘的，我可真跟过不少女人。"

units.source: "Hold on, that didn't sound quite right, lemme tune it."
units.zh: "等等，这声儿不对，让我调调。"

game_matches.translation: "等等，这声儿不对，让我调调。"

units.source: He raises his hand and twists his finger, then goes for another strum.
units.zh: 他抬手拧了拧手指，又拨一下。

game_matches.translation: 他抬手拧了拧手指，又拨一下。

units.source: "The hell? That was worse than the first. Just a sec, I'll get it, I promise."
units.zh: "见鬼？比刚才还糟。等会儿，我保证能调好。"

game_matches.translation: "见鬼？比刚才还糟。等会儿，我保证能调好。"

units.source: He tries again, but apparently this 'strum' wasn't any good either.
units.zh: 他再试，可这一“拨”显然还是不行。

game_matches.translation: 他再试，可这一“拨”显然还是不行。

units.source: The minstrel jumps to his feet and repeatedly smashes the invisible lute against the ground before heaving it into the tall grass. He sweeps the sweat from his brow.
units.zh: 吟游诗人跳起身，把那看不见的琴往地上砸了一次又一次，最后远远扔进高草。他抹去额头的汗。

game_matches.translation: 吟游诗人跳起身，把那看不见的琴往地上砸了一次又一次，最后远远扔进高草。他抹去额头的汗。

units.source: "You were right, dear father, I should have been a blacksmith."
units.zh: "亲爱的父亲，你说得对，我就该去当铁匠。"

game_matches.translation: "亲爱的父亲，你说得对，我就该去当铁匠。"

units.source: "The old gods said let there be light, did they not? 'Tis the first thing they did, so clearly light must be important."
units.zh: "旧神说，要有光，对吧？这是祂们最先做的事，所以光显然很重要。"

game_matches.translation: "旧神说，要有光，对吧？这是祂们最先做的事，所以光显然很重要。"

units.source: He picks up a piece of dirt and seems to analyze it.
units.zh: 他捡起一块土，似乎在仔细研究。

game_matches.translation: 他捡起一块土，似乎在仔细研究。

units.source: "So why is there so much pleasure to be found where a woman is darkest?"
units.zh: "那为什么，女人最暗的地方，偏偏藏着最多乐趣？"

game_matches.translation: "那为什么，女人最暗的地方，偏偏藏着最多乐趣？"

units.source: "Shall I show you fools how to dance?"
units.zh: "要不要我教教你们这些笨蛋，什么叫跳舞？"

game_matches.translation: "要不要我教教你们这些笨蛋，什么叫跳舞？"

units.source: A few men look up and shake their heads.
units.zh: 几个弟兄抬头，摇了摇头。

game_matches.translation: 几个弟兄抬头，摇了摇头。

units.source: "I, uh... well, that's all folks! So hopefully you got the moves down pat!"
units.zh: "我，呃……好了，各位，到此为止！希望你们都把动作学会了！"

game_matches.translation: "我，呃……好了，各位，到此为止！希望你们都把动作学会了！"

units.source: Only problem is that he doesn't yet have the goods - he has to buy them from some local in the nearby hinterlands. All he needs now is a bit of money to get him started and help purchase the goods. A sum of 500 crowns all in all. Naturally, as a partner, you will get a cut of the profits once it's all said and done.
units.zh: 唯一的问题是，货还没到手，得先去附近乡下向当地人购买。他只需要一点启动的本钱，总共500克朗，帮他把货置齐。既然你是合伙人，事成之后，自然能分得一份利润。

game_matches.translation: 唯一的问题是，货还没到手，得先去附近乡下向当地人购买。他只需要一点启动的本钱，总共500克朗，帮他把货置齐。既然你是合伙人，事成之后，自然能分得一份利润。

units.source: A few hours later, the peddler comes running up with a small lockbox in hand. The wily grin on his face is undeniable and he's unwittingly fistpumping as he glides to you. When he tries to speak, gasps of breath seize him. You hold your hand out, telling him to take his time. Settling down, the man hands over a heavy purse of coins, stating that it is your cut of the profits.
units.zh: 几个时辰后，小贩抱着一个带锁的小箱子跑回来，满脸藏不住的狡黠笑意，一边靠近，一边不自觉地挥拳庆贺。他想开口，却喘得说不成话。你抬手，让他慢慢来。缓过气后，他递上一只沉甸甸的钱袋，说这是分给你的利润。

game_matches.translation: 几个时辰后，小贩抱着一个带锁的小箱子跑回来，满脸藏不住的狡黠笑意，一边靠近，一边不自觉地挥拳庆贺。他想开口，却喘得说不成话。你抬手，让他慢慢来。缓过气后，他递上一只沉甸甸的钱袋，说这是分给你的利润。

units.source: Before you can even say anything, the man wheels on his heels and jumps away, giddy with his success.
units.zh: 你还没来得及说什么，他便脚跟一转，蹦跳着离开，兴奋得忘乎所以。

game_matches.translation: 你还没来得及说什么，他便脚跟一转，蹦跳着离开，兴奋得忘乎所以。

units.source: As you step out of your tent hours later, you see a slumped shape in the distance, steadily heading your way. It appears to be the peddler. He carries nothing with him but a frown. As he gets closer, you begin to see the bruises that dot his body. He explains that while he managed to purchase the goods from his source, the actual townspeople weren't particularly warm to his selling tactics.
units.zh: 几个时辰后，你走出帐篷，看见远处一个垂头丧气的身影正慢慢靠近。似乎是那小贩，除了满脸苦相，什么也没带。走近后，你才看清他身上遍布的淤伤。他解释，货确实从熟人那里买到了，可镇民们对他的推销手法并不怎么欣赏。

game_matches.translation: 几个时辰后，你走出帐篷，看见远处一个垂头丧气的身影正慢慢靠近。似乎是那小贩，除了满脸苦相，什么也没带。走近后，你才看清他身上遍布的淤伤。他解释，货确实从熟人那里买到了，可镇民们对他的推销手法并不怎么欣赏。

units.source: "One time, I was out in this pithy nobleman's lands hunting this buck. Shooting the damned deer was the easy part. In the middle of field dressing it, I hear hooves beating over the earth. So run a rope up a tree, tie the carcass to it, and haul that sucker up there. No more than a minute later, badda-badda-badda, there's the nobleman with the constable and a retinue of lawmen."
units.zh: "有一回，我跑到一个小气贵族的领地，猎一头公鹿。射倒那该死的鹿倒容易，难的是剖到一半，忽然听见马蹄声。我赶紧把绳子甩上树，绑住鹿尸，把那家伙吊上去。没过一分钟，哒哒哒哒，贵族就带着治安官和一队执法者来了。"

game_matches.translation: "有一回，我跑到一个小气贵族的领地，猎一头公鹿。射倒那该死的鹿倒容易，难的是剖到一半，忽然听见马蹄声。我赶紧把绳子甩上树，绑住鹿尸，把那家伙吊上去。没过一分钟，哒哒哒哒，贵族就带着治安官和一队执法者来了。"

units.source: "Tighter than a cross-legged virgin it was. So this nobleman comes wandering just underneath me and sees all the blood. He starts barking that I come out and turn myself in. I had no intention of doing that, but unfortunately, the goddam buck starts slipping. I reach out for it and I suppose the branch couldn't take no more and snapped. The nobleman looks up just in time to get splattered by the belly of this deer, meanwhile I'm falling to certain death until the damned rope snags my foot and hangs me upside down before my makers. I give a bit of a wave, 'hey fellas, don't mean to barge in like this.'"
units.zh: "挤得比夹紧腿的处女还紧。那贵族正好走到我下面，看见满地血，便开始吼，叫我出来自首。我压根没打算照做，可倒霉的是，那该死的鹿开始往下滑。我伸手去抓，树枝大概再也撑不住，咔嚓断了。贵族刚抬起头，就被鹿肚子砸了个正着。我也正往下掉，眼看必死，偏偏那破绳子缠住我的脚，把我倒吊在这群能要我命的家伙面前。我挥了挥手：“嘿，各位，不是有意这样打扰。”"

game_matches.translation: "挤得比夹紧腿的处女还紧。那贵族正好走到我下面，看见满地血，便开始吼，叫我出来自首。我压根没打算照做，可倒霉的是，那该死的鹿开始往下滑。我伸手去抓，树枝大概再也撑不住，咔嚓断了。贵族刚抬起头，就被鹿肚子砸了个正着。我也正往下掉，眼看必死，偏偏那破绳子缠住我的脚，把我倒吊在这群能要我命的家伙面前。我挥了挥手：“嘿，各位，不是有意这样打扰。”"

units.source: "Oh, they had a sense of humor about it, thank the old gods. I spent a short six months in a dark pit. Nothing too bad, really."
units.zh: "噢，幸好他们还有点幽默感，感谢旧神。我只在黑坑里待了短短六个月。真没什么大不了。"

game_matches.translation: "噢，幸好他们还有点幽默感，感谢旧神。我只在黑坑里待了短短六个月。真没什么大不了。"

units.source: He explains that rat isn't the most nutritious of animals, nor the healthiest, but it'd help the company enough until they can get back to a town or farm. You reluctantly agree to keep your men from starving.
units.zh: 他解释说，老鼠谈不上多有营养，也不算多干净，不过足以帮战团撑到下一个城镇或农场。为了不让弟兄们饿死，你勉强同意了。

game_matches.translation: 他解释说，老鼠谈不上多有营养，也不算多干净，不过足以帮战团撑到下一个城镇或农场。为了不让弟兄们饿死，你勉强同意了。

units.source: The ratcatcher purses his lips. He slowly lowers the net.
units.zh: 捕鼠人抿了抿嘴，慢慢放下网。

game_matches.translation: 捕鼠人抿了抿嘴，慢慢放下网。

units.source: "Oh, I meant... to use it... to snag me some rat..."
units.zh: "哦，我本来……是想拿它……抓几只老鼠……"

game_matches.translation: "哦，我本来……是想拿它……抓几只老鼠……"

units.source: He pauses, then throws his head up, a cheeky if not cheesy smile adorned across it.
units.zh: 他停了停，随后猛地抬头，挤出一个俏皮却有些做作的笑。

game_matches.translation: 他停了停，随后猛地抬头，挤出一个俏皮却有些做作的笑。

units.source: "But I shall use it on the field of battle! No rat, man or furry or that which scurries, shall escape me!"
units.zh: "不过，我会把它用在战场上！不管是两条腿的耗子，还是长毛乱窜的耗子，谁也别想逃出我的手心！"

game_matches.translation: "不过，我会把它用在战场上！不管是两条腿的耗子，还是长毛乱窜的耗子，谁也别想逃出我的手心！"

units.source: "Was. Might be again someday. What's it to you?"
units.zh: "以前是。说不定哪天还会干回去。关你什么事？"

game_matches.translation: "以前是。说不定哪天还会干回去。关你什么事？"

units.source: "It were men like you who forced good people out of their homes. Good people to drag their whole lives onto the damned road."
units.zh: "就是你这种人，把好人赶出自己的家，逼着他们把一辈子的家当拖到该死的路上去！"

game_matches.translation: "就是你这种人，把好人赶出自己的家，逼着他们把一辈子的家当拖到该死的路上去！"

units.source: "Oh, is that right? And what made them so good? That they couldn't swing a sword or protect themselves? Do you believe for one moment that were the boot on the other foot they wouldn't do the same to me? Or to you, too? Folk are only as good as their options."
units.zh: "噢，是吗？他们哪儿好了？不会挥剑，保不住自己，就叫好人？你真信换个处境，他们不会对我干同样的事？甚至对你也一样？人有多善良，不过看他有多少选择。"

game_matches.translation: "噢，是吗？他们哪儿好了？不会挥剑，保不住自己，就叫好人？你真信换个处境，他们不会对我干同样的事？甚至对你也一样？人有多善良，不过看他有多少选择。"

units.source: The spate's getting wild and some of the other mercenaries get to their feet. Nobody can stop the initial scuffle, the two men exchanging blows and curses as good as any tavern brawl you've seen. Thankfully, nothing too serious comes of the fight.
units.zh: 争吵越来越激烈，其他几个佣兵也站了起来。谁都没来得及拦住最先那一阵扭打，两人拳脚与脏话齐飞，不逊于你见过的任何一场酒馆斗殴。好在这架终究没闹出太严重的后果。

game_matches.translation: 争吵越来越激烈，其他几个佣兵也站了起来。谁都没来得及拦住最先那一阵扭打，两人拳脚与脏话齐飞，不逊于你见过的任何一场酒馆斗殴。好在这架终究没闹出太严重的后果。

units.source: The sellsword looks at the ground, thinking your words over. Finally he nods and agrees to stay. You tell him he's made the right choice. The man turns and taps a quiver of arrows as he walks away.
units.zh: 佣兵低头思索着你的话，终于点头答应留下。你告诉他，这是正确的选择。他转身走开时，拍了拍一只箭袋。

game_matches.translation: 佣兵低头思索着你的话，终于点头答应留下。你告诉他，这是正确的选择。他转身走开时，拍了拍一只箭袋。

units.source: The sellsword looks at the ground, thinking your words over. Finally he shakes his head and purses his lips with a look of 'sorry'. You tell him he's making the wrong choice, but he's having none of it. The man turns and taps a quiver of arrows as he walks away.
units.zh: 佣兵低头看着地面，琢磨你的话。最终，他还是摇了摇头，抿着嘴，满脸歉意。你告诉他，这是个错误的选择，但他已听不进去。男人转身离开，顺手拍了拍一筒箭。

game_matches.translation: 佣兵低头看着地面，琢磨你的话。最终，他还是摇了摇头，抿着嘴，满脸歉意。你告诉他，这是个错误的选择，但他已听不进去。男人转身离开，顺手拍了拍一筒箭。

units.source: The arrows are a little low, but all you can think about is figuring out how to replace a good swordhand such as he.
units.zh: 箭确实不多了，可你满脑子想的，都是上哪儿再找一个像他这样的好手。

game_matches.translation: 箭确实不多了，可你满脑子想的，都是上哪儿再找一个像他这样的好手。

units.source: "Lemme, lemme, lemme get this straight. Y-you use a stick, and so they follow because you have the stick? It's all about the stick?"
units.zh: "让、让、让我捋一捋。你拿着一根棍子，所以它们就跟着你？就因为你有那根棍子？关键全在棍子上？"

game_matches.translation: "让、让、让我捋一捋。你拿着一根棍子，所以它们就跟着你？就因为你有那根棍子？关键全在棍子上？"

units.source: "I prefer to call it a staff, but yes. Sheep are simple creatures and all that they demand is a leader. The staff is an itemization of my role. I wield the staff, therefore I am the leader. At least in a little sheep's eyes. An obedient dog helps a lot, too. Truthfully, a dog would be the true leader did they not have the loyalty and honor we wished we had ourselves."
units.zh: "我更愿意叫它牧杖，不过，没错。羊是很简单的动物，只需要一个领头的。牧杖就是我身份的象征。我拿着牧杖，所以我就是头领。至少在小羊眼里是这样。有条听话的狗，也能帮上大忙。说实话，要不是狗有着连我们都自愧不如的忠诚和荣誉，真正的头领就该是它们了。"

game_matches.translation: "我更愿意叫它牧杖，不过，没错。羊是很简单的动物，只需要一个领头的。牧杖就是我身份的象征。我拿着牧杖，所以我就是头领。至少在小羊眼里是这样。有条听话的狗，也能帮上大忙。说实话，要不是狗有着连我们都自愧不如的忠诚和荣誉，真正的头领就该是它们了。"

units.source: "I'll have to try the stick, I mean staff, with my rats. And get a dog, too."
units.zh: "我得拿棍子——我是说牧杖——去对我的老鼠试试。再弄条狗。"

game_matches.translation: "我得拿棍子——我是说牧杖——去对我的老鼠试试。再弄条狗。"

units.source: "Or a cat. What? I'm joking, friend, just joking."
units.zh: "也可以弄只猫。怎么了？朋友，开个玩笑，开个玩笑而已。"

game_matches.translation: "也可以弄只猫。怎么了？朋友，开个玩笑，开个玩笑而已。"

units.source: "I don't know about the rest of you sad clods, but I think I could run this camp better than anyone! Especially better than him!"
units.zh: "你们这些可怜虫怎么想，我不知道。反正我觉得，这营地交给我，肯定比谁都管得好！尤其比他强！"

game_matches.translation: "你们这些可怜虫怎么想，我不知道。反正我觉得，这营地交给我，肯定比谁都管得好！尤其比他强！"

units.source: You take a seat. The men are staring at you, waiting for a response.
units.zh: 你坐下来。弟兄们都盯着你，等你回应。

game_matches.translation: 你坐下来。弟兄们都盯着你，等你回应。
你坐下来。弟兄们都盯着你，等你回应。

units.source: {#1}{#2}You're totally right. You should be in charge.{/#2}{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 你说得对极了。该由你来当团长。

units.source: {#1}{#2}I'm in charge here! This is my company!{/#2}{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 这里我说了算！这是我的战团！

units.source: You kick your feet out, legs akimbo, and place your hands in your lap. Nodding, you speak to the man.
units.zh: 你舒展双腿，把手放在膝上，点着头对那人说道。

game_matches.translation: 你舒展双腿，把手放在膝上，点着头对那人说道。

units.source: You throw a hand out to a few of the tents.
units.zh: 你抬手指了指几顶帐篷。

game_matches.translation: 你抬手指了指几顶帐篷。

units.source: "You'll also need to keep a steady count on your people. They're not easily controlled, to which you might find some irony - or not."
units.zh: "你还得随时管好手下。他们可不好管，这话听起来是不是有点讽刺——也许你听不出来。"

game_matches.translation: "你还得随时管好手下。他们可不好管，这话听起来是不是有点讽刺——也许你听不出来。"

units.source: Looking at your hands, which have grown calloused and bruised over the days, you keep talking.
units.zh: 你低头看看那双日渐长满老茧、遍布瘀伤的手，继续说。

game_matches.translation: 你低头看看那双日渐长满老茧、遍布瘀伤的手，继续说。

units.source: You immediately jump back to your feet and begin shouting.
units.zh: 你立刻跳起来，放声怒吼。

game_matches.translation: 你立刻跳起来，放声怒吼。

units.source: "Look at you bunch of sorry sad sacks. Do you think you're unique? Do you think you're the first to feel like shit? No, of course not. You'd not be the first to give up, either. To lay down and not rise again. That's the easy thing to do. That's what the world wants you to do. There's enough sonsabitches around, no need in having some sorry asses like yourselves mucking things up if you don't want no part and parcel in this punishment we call life."
units.zh: "看看你们这帮丧气包。以为自己多特别？以为自己是头一个觉得日子烂透的人？当然不是。就算放弃，你们也不会是第一个。往地上一躺，再也不起身，多容易啊。这世道就盼着你们这么干。世上混蛋已经够多，要是你们不想在这叫作人生的酷刑里挣扎，就没必要再留着一群垂头丧气的家伙添乱。"

game_matches.translation: "看看你们这帮丧气包。以为自己多特别？以为自己是头一个觉得日子烂透的人？当然不是。就算放弃，你们也不会是第一个。往地上一躺，再也不起身，多容易啊。这世道就盼着你们这么干。世上混蛋已经够多，要是你们不想在这叫作人生的酷刑里挣扎，就没必要再留着一群垂头丧气的家伙添乱。"

units.source: Roused by this speech, you see a bit of a glint falling over the company.
units.zh: 这番话激起了众人的精神，你看见弟兄们眼里重新有了一点光。

game_matches.translation: 这番话激起了众人的精神，你看见弟兄们眼里重新有了一点光。

units.source: "I'm not taking the world's shit. I'm gonna make the world sorry for having me here. I didn't ask for no invitation so I ain't gonna play nice to this farkin' party. See you in the next life, men, but until then, let's dance in this one!"
units.zh: "我不受这世道的鸟气。我要让这世道后悔把我弄到这儿来。我又没求它请我来，凭什么在这场破宴席上规规矩矩？弟兄们，来世再见吧；不过在那之前，先把这辈子闹个痛快！"

game_matches.translation: "我不受这世道的鸟气。我要让这世道后悔把我弄到这儿来。我又没求它请我来，凭什么在这场破宴席上规规矩矩？弟兄们，来世再见吧；不过在那之前，先把这辈子闹个痛快！"

units.source: A cheer erupts and the men get to their feet, a sense of elation bursting forth as though the ground had them chained all along.
units.zh: 欢呼声骤然响起，弟兄们纷纷站起，兴奋之情喷薄而出，仿佛一直锁住他们的地面突然松开了镣铐。

game_matches.translation: 欢呼声骤然响起，弟兄们纷纷站起，兴奋之情喷薄而出，仿佛一直锁住他们的地面突然松开了镣铐。

units.source: {#1}{#2}You'll get what we agreed upon and no more.{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}{#2}说好多少就是多少，一个子儿也不多。{/#2}{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 说好多少就是多少，一个子儿也不多。

units.source: "Thank you, sir. I thought I might have to, I dunno."
units.zh: "谢谢，长官。我还以为自己得……唉，我也说不清。"

game_matches.translation: "谢谢，长官。我还以为自己得……唉，我也说不清。"

units.source: The man awkwardly laughs and shakes his head.
units.zh: 男人尴尬地笑着，连忙摇头。

game_matches.translation: 男人尴尬地笑着，连忙摇头。

units.source: He raises his arms and swings them a little. You burst into laughter.
units.zh: 他举起胳膊，晃了几下。你放声大笑。

game_matches.translation: 他举起胳膊，晃了几下。你放声大笑。

units.source: "No number of kills would amount to whatever that was."
units.zh: "杀再多人，也抵不上刚才这一出。"

game_matches.translation: "杀再多人，也抵不上刚才这一出。"

units.source: "Spare me the ceremony. I'm here to kill, let's not dance around it."
units.zh: "省了这些客套吧。我是来杀人的，咱们别绕弯子。"

game_matches.translation: "省了这些客套吧。我是来杀人的，咱们别绕弯子。"

units.source: "Well, fark this shit. I'll still fight fer ya, but don't expect the best out of me!"
units.zh: "去他娘的！我还是会替你打仗，不过别指望我卖力！"

game_matches.translation: "去他娘的！我还是会替你打仗，不过别指望我卖力！"

units.source: "Alright then, I see how this place is run. In we go, out we go. No matter to you, right? We're just the pawns you use to get what you want. That's fine. That's absolutely fine."
units.zh: "行吧，我算看明白这里怎么回事了。招进来，送出去。你根本不在乎，对吧？我们就是让你得偿所愿的棋子。行，完全没问题。"

game_matches.translation: "行吧，我算看明白这里怎么回事了。招进来，送出去。你根本不在乎，对吧？我们就是让你得偿所愿的棋子。行，完全没问题。"

units.source: "But that's alright. I get the business. And I'm sure you understand that you get why I must look after the business that is myself, too."
units.zh: "不过没关系。生意嘛，我懂。那你肯定也能明白，我也得照顾好我自己这门生意。"

game_matches.translation: "不过没关系。生意嘛，我懂。那你肯定也能明白，我也得照顾好我自己这门生意。"

units.source: "You'll get what we agreed upon, no more."
units.zh: "说好多少，你就拿多少，一分不加。"

game_matches.translation: "说好多少，你就拿多少，一分不加。"

units.source: He nods and then slowly back out of the tent.
units.zh: 他点头，慢慢退出帐篷。

game_matches.translation: 他点头，慢慢退出帐篷。

units.source: "To hell with those savages! To hell with the greenskins! My life is unfinished so long as they are allowed to walk the same earth as me, my kin, or my children's kin! I will rip their tusks from their mouths, ravage their women, I don't know if they have women, don't know if I'd go near them if they did actually, but I'll ravage something and see to it an annihilation so fierce and thorough the old gods will come to me to borrow a tip!"
units.zh: "让那些野蛮东西见鬼去！让绿皮见鬼去！只要它们还跟我、我的亲人、我的子孙踏着同一片土地，我这辈子就不算完！我要拔掉它们的獠牙，糟蹋它们的女人——我不知道它们有没有女人，就算有，我也不知道自己敢不敢靠近——反正我要狠狠干一场，把它们灭得干干净净，连旧神都得来向我请教！"

game_matches.translation: "让那些野蛮东西见鬼去！让绿皮见鬼去！只要它们还跟我、我的亲人、我的子孙踏着同一片土地，我这辈子就不算完！我要拔掉它们的獠牙，糟蹋它们的女人——我不知道它们有没有女人，就算有，我也不知道自己敢不敢靠近——反正我要狠狠干一场，把它们灭得干干净净，连旧神都得来向我请教！"

units.source: "The old gods will have our arses if we permit the dead to walk again! You fellas can go to the hereafter thinking you did right in this world, but I ain't following the idle road cause by my sum that road goes straight to the hells. I'll see to it that I meet a righteous end, and I'll see to that by felling every godforsaken undead fark I see!"
units.zh: "放任死人爬起来走路，旧神绝不会饶过我们！你们尽管去另一个世界，自以为这辈子没做错什么；可我不走袖手旁观那条路，依我看，那路直通地狱。我要死得堂堂正正，为此，我见到一个该死的亡灵混账，就要砍倒一个！"

game_matches.translation: "放任死人爬起来走路，旧神绝不会饶过我们！你们尽管去另一个世界，自以为这辈子没做错什么；可我不走袖手旁观那条路，依我看，那路直通地狱。我要死得堂堂正正，为此，我见到一个该死的亡灵混账，就要砍倒一个！"

units.source: "Not all of life can be spent standin', fellas. Sometimes it's gotta be spent getting' back up. But we'll never spend it layin' down forever, I know that much! This company's too good for that lollygaggin' shite."
units.zh: "弟兄们，人这一生不可能总站着，有些时候就是得从地上爬起来。可我们绝不会躺着一辈子不起，我敢打包票！咱们这战团这么好，才不会干那种窝囊事。"

game_matches.translation: "弟兄们，人这一生不可能总站着，有些时候就是得从地上爬起来。可我们绝不会躺着一辈子不起，我敢打包票！咱们这战团这么好，才不会干那种窝囊事。"

units.source: The ever optimistic sellsword's relentless positivity rubs off on some of the men, raising their spirits and leaving them ready for the tomorrows to come.
units.zh: 这个始终乐观的佣兵把那股不屈的积极劲儿传给了几个人，让他们振作起来，准备迎接明天。

game_matches.translation: 这个始终乐观的佣兵把那股不屈的积极劲儿传给了几个人，让他们振作起来，准备迎接明天。

units.source: You put your head down for a nap.
units.zh: 你低头小睡片刻。

game_matches.translation: 你低头小睡片刻。
你低头小睡片刻。

units.source: The silky bedsheet slides off your body as you roll to a side. Birds flutter past a sleek, ivory-framed window. A voice pours into your ear, a hint of an aroma you've never smelled before gracing you.
units.zh: 翻身时，丝滑的床单从身上滑落。鸟儿掠过光洁的象牙窗框，一道声音流进耳中，带来一缕从未闻过的幽香。

game_matches.translation: 翻身时，丝滑的床单从身上滑落。鸟儿掠过光洁的象牙窗框，一道声音流进耳中，带来一缕从未闻过的幽香。

units.source: A woman rolls herself over, running a finger down your chest before going back up and seizing your chin. Lithe, pretty, the sun glowing across her smooth face, and lighting up a set of emerald eyes. She goes for a kiss. You quickly slide out of the bed and frantically look around. She grips the sheets and comes to her knees, confused.
units.zh: 一个女人翻身靠近，指尖沿你胸口向下，又向上，轻轻托住下巴。她身姿轻盈，容貌秀美，阳光掠过光滑的脸颊，映亮一双翡翠般的眼睛。她想吻你。你却迅速下床，慌忙打量四周。她攥着床单跪坐起来，满脸困惑。

game_matches.translation: 一个女人翻身靠近，指尖沿你胸口向下，又向上，轻轻托住下巴。她身姿轻盈，容貌秀美，阳光掠过光滑的脸颊，映亮一双翡翠般的眼睛。她想吻你。你却迅速下床，慌忙打量四周。她攥着床单跪坐起来，满脸困惑。

units.source: "What's wrong? Where are you going my Emperor?"
units.zh: "怎么了？我的皇帝，你要去哪儿？"

game_matches.translation: "怎么了？我的皇帝，你要去哪儿？"

units.source: Looking up, you see a ceiling that stretches so far up you can hardly even see the artwork which has been exquisitely embroidered there. You open a door and step out onto a balcony. Impossibly tall buildings, red, white, gold banners, a horizon steepled with black shapes stretching as far as the eye wishes to see. Domes, fountains, great arches, statues that stand so tall they seem to be commanding the structures as soldiers. Atop each roof is a garden greater and more flush than anything you've seen in the eternal springs of nature itself. Suddenly, two men emerges at your sides with cages of doves and let them out. The birds desperately scatter and just then a roar erupts beneath you. Great crowds of people jumping and waving banners around.
units.zh: 抬头望去，天花板高得几乎看不清上面精美的图案。你推开一扇门，走上阳台。建筑高得不可思议，红、白、金色的旗帜处处飘扬，黑色尖塔的轮廓铺满天际，一直延伸到视线尽头。穹顶、喷泉、宏伟拱门，还有高耸的雕像，仿佛正将周围建筑当作士兵统领。每座屋顶都有花园，比你在大自然最丰盛的春天里见过的还要壮丽葱郁。突然，两个人提着鸽笼出现在你两侧，开笼放飞。鸟儿拼命散去，脚下随即爆发欢呼。无数人跳跃着，挥舞旗帜。

game_matches.translation: 抬头望去，天花板高得几乎看不清上面精美的图案。你推开一扇门，走上阳台。建筑高得不可思议，红、白、金色的旗帜处处飘扬，黑色尖塔的轮廓铺满天际，一直延伸到视线尽头。穹顶、喷泉、宏伟拱门，还有高耸的雕像，仿佛正将周围建筑当作士兵统领。每座屋顶都有花园，比你在大自然最丰盛的春天里见过的还要壮丽葱郁。突然，两个人提着鸽笼出现在你两侧，开笼放飞。鸟儿拼命散去，脚下随即爆发欢呼。无数人跳跃着，挥舞旗帜。

units.source: You look down to see a stream of soldiers marching down the middle of the road, each man stepping in unison with his brother, a steady staccato clap of boots. Their faces stern in their gilded helms, long polearms glistening upward as though they meant to defeat their enemies with opulence itself.
units.zh: 你低头，看见士兵沿大道中央源源行进，每一步都与身旁同袍整齐一致，靴声短促有力，节奏分明。镀金头盔下，面容肃穆，长柄兵器高举闪光，仿佛要凭奢华本身击败敌人。

game_matches.translation: 你低头，看见士兵沿大道中央源源行进，每一步都与身旁同袍整齐一致，靴声短促有力，节奏分明。镀金头盔下，面容肃穆，长柄兵器高举闪光，仿佛要凭奢华本身击败敌人。

units.source: "They're going off to war. To face the Great Beyond, and to defeat it."
units.zh: "他们要去打仗，面对彼岸，征服彼岸。"

game_matches.translation: "他们要去打仗，面对彼岸，征服彼岸。"

units.source: The woman is at your side. She smiles warmly, taking you by the arm. You feel ready to agree to it, to this new reality, whatever it be. You take her by the cheek, ready to fall into her embrace, but a cry from below wails loud and clear over all else. You glance down to see the soldiers, once joined in perfect uniformity, breaking rank. In the distance, a great mountain is erupting, jetting great bursts of red fire and an enormous cloud of hot ash which quickly pools into the city. Buildings disintegrate, gardens burst into flames, and the people... the people scream. They turn away, but there is no escaping the heat. The soldiers collapse and scream. A surging, searing heat, and soon enough you see the denizens melting in it, the soldiers becoming metal golems, singed into the very armor which was meant to protect them, and the unarmored crowds simply burst aflame. The woman cries at your side.
units.zh: 女人已来到身边，温柔地微笑，挽住你的胳膊。你觉得自己愿意接受这一切，接受这个新的现实，无论它究竟是什么。你抚住她的脸颊，正要投入怀抱，脚下却传来一声清晰的尖叫，压过所有声响。低头望去，方才整齐如一的士兵正阵脚大乱。远处，一座大山喷发，赤焰冲天，庞大的炽热灰云迅速涌入城中。建筑崩解，花园起火，人们……人们在尖叫。他们转身逃跑，却避不开热浪。士兵倒地惨呼，灼热一波接一波涌来。很快，你看见居民在其中熔化；士兵与本该护体的盔甲烧熔在一起，成了金属魔像；没有盔甲的人群，则直接化作火焰。身边的女人哭喊：

game_matches.translation: 女人已来到身边，温柔地微笑，挽住你的胳膊。你觉得自己愿意接受这一切，接受这个新的现实，无论它究竟是什么。你抚住她的脸颊，正要投入怀抱，脚下却传来一声清晰的尖叫，压过所有声响。低头望去，方才整齐如一的士兵正阵脚大乱。远处，一座大山喷发，赤焰冲天，庞大的炽热灰云迅速涌入城中。建筑崩解，花园起火，人们……人们在尖叫。他们转身逃跑，却避不开热浪。士兵倒地惨呼，灼热一波接一波涌来。很快，你看见居民在其中熔化；士兵与本该护体的盔甲烧熔在一起，成了金属魔像；没有盔甲的人群，则直接化作火焰。身边的女人哭喊：

units.source: "We'll rise again, Emperor! We... shall... rise... again!"
units.zh: "我们会再起的，皇帝！我们……终将……再次……崛起！"

game_matches.translation: "我们会再起的，皇帝！我们……终将……再次……崛起！"

units.source: Her skull breaks apart and her body collapses into a pile of burning bones.
units.zh: 她的头骨碎裂，身体塌成一堆燃烧的骸骨。

game_matches.translation: 她的头骨碎裂，身体塌成一堆燃烧的骸骨。

units.source: "Sir, wakeup! We've got a group of refugees here saying that the dead are rising from the earth and killing everything in sight!"
units.zh: "团长，醒醒！来了一群难民，说死人正在从地下爬出来，见什么杀什么！"

game_matches.translation: "团长，醒醒！来了一群难民，说死人正在从地下爬出来，见什么杀什么！"

units.source: The woman's face flashes before your eyes. It is horrifically scarred, but this doesn't stop her from grinning.
units.zh: 女人的脸在眼前闪过，伤痕狰狞，却仍咧嘴笑着。

game_matches.translation: 女人的脸在眼前闪过，伤痕狰狞，却仍咧嘴笑着。

units.source: Marching along, you spot a fellow traveler who leans forward and then back and then forward again, all the while his hand knowing not whether to shield the sun or peel away to let himself be blinded. He shakes his head and spits.
units.zh: 行军途中，你遇到一个旅人。他身子前倾，又后仰，接着再凑近，手也不知该举起来遮太阳，还是干脆拿开，任由阳光晃瞎眼睛。他摇摇头，啐了一口。

game_matches.translation: 行军途中，你遇到一个旅人。他身子前倾，又后仰，接着再凑近，手也不知该举起来遮太阳，还是干脆拿开，任由阳光晃瞎眼睛。他摇摇头，啐了一口。

units.source: "I'd heard word of you folks. Buncha trouserless men in a land of evil, like some devil's little joke sprung to life. The hell are you?"
units.zh: "早听说过你们。这么个妖魔横行的世道，偏有一帮不穿裤子的家伙到处跑，活像恶魔开了个玩笑，还真成了精。你们到底是什么东西？"

game_matches.translation: "早听说过你们。这么个妖魔横行的世道，偏有一帮不穿裤子的家伙到处跑，活像恶魔开了个玩笑，还真成了精。你们到底是什么东西？"

units.source: You shrug and tell the man that, so far, you've no issue with taking on your troubles sans leather or plate or cloth of loin. Again, the traveler shakes his head and spits.
units.zh: 你耸耸肩，告诉他，至少到目前为止，不穿皮甲、板甲，连兜裆布也省了，并不耽误你们应付麻烦。旅人又摇头，又吐了口唾沫。

game_matches.translation: 你耸耸肩，告诉他，至少到目前为止，不穿皮甲、板甲，连兜裆布也省了，并不耽误你们应付麻烦。旅人又摇头，又吐了口唾沫。

units.source: "Farkin' hell. A man in battle with nothing on him is more naked than the day he'd done been born! I s'pose the irony is that if we - and I mean anybody-we - come find ya dead in the fields, then we'll probably dress ya better for the grave than you dress yourself now. Which shan't be hard, seeing as how you've dressed yourself none at all."
units.zh: "见鬼。光着身子上战场，比刚从娘胎里出来还赤裸！说来也好笑，要是哪天我们——我是说随便什么人——在野地里发现你们的尸体，收殓时给你们穿的，多半都比你们现在体面。这倒也不难，毕竟你们现在压根没穿。"

game_matches.translation: "见鬼。光着身子上战场，比刚从娘胎里出来还赤裸！说来也好笑，要是哪天我们——我是说随便什么人——在野地里发现你们的尸体，收殓时给你们穿的，多半都比你们现在体面。这倒也不难，毕竟你们现在压根没穿。"

units.source: With a bit of a wave, you thank the traveler for his kind words before continuing your merry march.
units.zh: 你挥挥手，谢过旅人的好意，随后继续愉快地赶路。

game_matches.translation: 你挥挥手，谢过旅人的好意，随后继续愉快地赶路。

units.source: {#1}The glimmering blade of a broken sword you retrieved from the Kraken. In all your years of fighting you never encountered such a masterfully crafted blade. Perhaps the sword could be reforged if you had both parts.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}从克拉肯那里取得的断剑剑刃，闪着微光。征战多年，你从未见过工艺如此精湛的剑刃。若能凑齐两个部分，或许就能将它重铸。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 从克拉肯那里取得的断剑剑刃，闪着微光。征战多年，你从未见过工艺如此精湛的剑刃。若能凑齐两个部分，或许就能将它重铸。

units.source: {#1}A masterfully crafted sword grip covered in mysterious blue stones. The stones seem to have a glimmering light emerging from deep within. Perhaps the sword could be reforged if you had both parts.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一枚工艺精湛的剑柄，镶满神秘的蓝色石头，石头深处仿佛透着微光。若能凑齐两个部分，或许就能将这把剑重铸。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一枚工艺精湛的剑柄，镶满神秘的蓝色石头，石头深处仿佛透着微光。若能凑齐两个部分，或许就能将这把剑重铸。

units.source: "Well, it's something. Whoever left this here left a short while ago. Probably spooked by whatever the hell lives out here in the day-to-day."
units.zh: "总算没白找。把车扔在这儿的人，应该刚走不久。八成是被这鬼地方常住的那些东西吓跑了。"

game_matches.translation: "总算没白找。把车扔在这儿的人，应该刚走不久。八成是被这鬼地方常住的那些东西吓跑了。"

units.source: "No reason in leaving behind what can be used."
units.zh: "还能用的东西，没道理就这么扔下。"

game_matches.translation: "还能用的东西，没道理就这么扔下。"

units.source: {#1}A quiver of bolts, required to use crossbows. Is automatically refilled after each battle if you have enough ammunition.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一个弩矢袋，使用弩时需要配备。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一个弩矢袋，使用弩时需要配备。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。

units.source: {#1}A quiver of arrows, required to use bows of all kinds. Is automatically refilled after each battle if you have enough ammunition.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一个箭袋，使用各类弓时需要配备。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一个箭袋，使用各类弓时需要配备。弹药储备充足时，每场战斗结束后会自动补满。

units.source: {#1}A leather sling on a metal-reinforced staff, used to hurl stones at the enemy. With stones abundant everywhere, it will never run out of ammunition.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}经过金属加固的长杖顶端系着皮革投石索，用来向敌人投掷石块。石头随处可得，因此永远不会缺少弹药。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 经过金属加固的长杖顶端系着皮革投石索，用来向敌人投掷石块。石头随处可得，因此永远不会缺少弹药。

units.source: {#1}A short bow made from composite layers for additional drawing power.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}由多层材料复合制成的短弓，拉力更强。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 由多层材料复合制成的短弓，拉力更强。

units.source: {#1}A curved sword typically found only in the southern reaches. Excellent for slashing, but not for thrusting or penetrating armor.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一种通常只见于南方的弯刀，擅长劈斩，却不适合刺击或穿透护甲。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一种通常只见于南方的弯刀，擅长劈斩，却不适合刺击或穿透护甲。

units.source: {#1}A curved blade notoriously used by assassins of the southern deserts. Particularly effective against targets already debilitated.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一柄弯刃匕首，因南方沙漠刺客的使用而恶名远扬。对已经陷入虚弱状态的目标格外有效。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一柄弯刃匕首，因南方沙漠刺客的使用而恶名远扬。对已经陷入虚弱状态的目标格外有效。

units.source: {#1}A heavy winged mace commonly used by well equipped soldiers of the southern reaches.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}南方装备精良的士兵常用的重型翼刃钉锤。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 南方装备精良的士兵常用的重型翼刃钉锤。

units.source: {#1}A metal mace with extended wings for added effectiveness against armor.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一柄金属钉锤，锤头伸出翼状刃片，对付护甲更加有效。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一柄金属钉锤，锤头伸出翼状刃片，对付护甲更加有效。

units.source: {#1}A simple wooden mace with a metal head. Weapons like this are popular among the nomads of the deserts.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}木柄配上金属锤头，构成了这柄简单的钉锤。这类武器颇受沙漠游牧民欢迎。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 木柄配上金属锤头，构成了这柄简单的钉锤。这类武器颇受沙漠游牧民欢迎。

units.source: {#1}A long mace that can be used to deliver stunning blows over a distance.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一柄长柄钉锤，能从较远处重击敌人，使其眩晕。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一柄长柄钉锤，能从较远处重击敌人，使其眩晕。

units.source: This character has gazed into the abyss, and the abyss has gazed right back at him, turning him quite mad. He often rambles unintelligibly, and his cryptic mind has become inaccessible both to his peers and to the enemy.
units.zh: 此角色凝视过深渊，而深渊也回望着他，彻底逼疯了他。他时常说些难以理解的胡话，诡异的心智既让同伴无法接近，也令敌人无从下手。

game_matches.translation: 此角色凝视过深渊，而深渊也回望着他，彻底逼疯了他。他时常说些难以理解的胡话，诡异的心智既让同伴无法接近，也令敌人无从下手。

units.source: {#1}A long pole attached to a sharp curved blade, used to deliver deep sweeping strikes over some distance.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}长杆上装着锋利的弯刃，可以从较远处横扫，切出深深的伤口。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 长杆上装着锋利的弯刃，可以从较远处横扫，切出深深的伤口。

units.source: {#1}A light wooden shield with a metal frame, covered in leather. Offers good protection against ranged attacks due to its size, but is not very sturdy.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}以金属包边、外覆皮革的轻木盾。盾面宽大，能较好地遮挡远程攻击，却不太坚固。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 以金属包边、外覆皮革的轻木盾。盾面宽大，能较好地遮挡远程攻击，却不太坚固。

units.source: {#1}A full metal round shield of southern design. Quite heavy, but also durable.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}南方式全金属圆盾。颇为沉重，却也十分耐用。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 南方式全金属圆盾。颇为沉重，却也十分耐用。

units.source: {#1}A long version of the Saif wielded with both hands. The curved blade can cleave gruesome wounds.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}加长的赛义夫弯刀，需要双手挥舞。弯曲的刀刃能劈出骇人的伤口。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 加长的赛义夫弯刀，需要双手挥舞。弯曲的刀刃能劈出骇人的伤口。

units.source: {#1}A large scimitar wielded with both hands. The curved blade cleaves right through any enemy.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}需要双手挥舞的大型弯刀。弯曲的刀刃足以劈开挡路的敌人。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 需要双手挥舞的大型弯刀。弯曲的刀刃足以劈开挡路的敌人。

units.source: {#1}This distinct red and black head wrap is traditionally worn by the most skilled warriors of the nomad tribes.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}独特的红黑头巾，依传统只有游牧部落中技艺最精湛的战士才会佩戴。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 独特的红黑头巾，依传统只有游牧部落中技艺最精湛的战士才会佩戴。

units.source: {#1}A thick head wrap with small hidden leather strings for added protection, adorned with a bronze scorpion.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}厚头巾内暗缝细皮条以加强防护，外饰一只青铜蝎子。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 厚头巾内暗缝细皮条以加强防护，外饰一只青铜蝎子。

units.source: {#1}A finely wrapped cloth turban with insignia declaring the wearer a learned engineer from the city states.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}精心缠成的布头巾，其徽记表明佩戴者是一位来自城邦、学识渊博的工程师。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 精心缠成的布头巾，其徽记表明佩戴者是一位来自城邦、学识渊博的工程师。

units.source: {#1}A finely wrapped cloth turban worn by those that practise the use of elaborate gunpowder weapons in armies of the city states.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}城邦军中使用精密火药武器的士兵佩戴的布头巾，缠裹得十分整齐。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 城邦军中使用精密火药武器的士兵佩戴的布头巾，缠裹得十分整齐。

units.source: {#1}A thick leather head wrap that protects against cuts and bruises.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}厚皮裹成的头巾，可以防止割伤和擦伤。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 厚皮裹成的头巾，可以防止割伤和擦伤。

units.source: {#1}A nomad style head wrap suited to protect against sun and heat.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}游牧式头巾，能够遮挡烈日与酷热。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 游牧式头巾，能够遮挡烈日与酷热。

units.source: {#1}An impressive metal helmet crafted to intimidate the opponents of pit fighters in arenas of the southern city states.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}气势十足的金属头盔，专为南方城邦竞技场中的斗士打造，用来震慑对手。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 气势十足的金属头盔，专为南方城邦竞技场中的斗士打造，用来震慑对手。

units.source: {#1}A heavy helmet made from overlapping metal plates.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}用层层搭叠的金属甲片制成的重盔。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 用层层搭叠的金属甲片制成的重盔。

units.source: {#1}An ornate metal shield with a bright gilded shine that reflects even the tiniest ray of light with the power of the sun itself.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}装饰华美的金属盾，镀金表面灿然生辉。即使只有一丝微光，也能反射出如烈日般的光芒。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 装饰华美的金属盾，镀金表面灿然生辉。即使只有一丝微光，也能反射出如烈日般的光芒。

units.source: {#1}The Agent has eyes and ears everywhere and knows where to go for current events to take advantage of and well-paying contracts both.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}密探的耳目遍布各地，哪里有时局可供利用，哪里有报酬丰厚的委托，他都了如指掌。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 密探的耳目遍布各地，哪里有时局可供利用，哪里有报酬丰厚的委托，他都了如指掌。

units.source: {#1}The Alchemist is knowledgeable in crafting all kinds of mysterious contraptions and concoctions from exotic ingredients when given access to taxidermist equipment, and uses less material to do so.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}炼金术士熟知各种奇巧器具与神秘药剂的制作方法。只要借用剥制工坊的设备，他就能将稀奇古怪的材料变成成品，而且耗材更少。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 炼金术士熟知各种奇巧器具与神秘药剂的制作方法。只要借用剥制工坊的设备，他就能将稀奇古怪的材料变成成品，而且耗材更少。

units.source: {#1}Mercenaries are good at getting arms and armor destroyed, but not at maintaining them. The Blacksmith will take care of this tedious task quickly and efficiently, and can mend even equipment otherwise thought lost.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}佣兵们糟蹋武器护甲的本事一流，保养起来却不在行。铁匠能迅速而高效地处理这些琐事，连原本以为报废了的装备也能修复。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 佣兵们糟蹋武器护甲的本事一流，保养起来却不在行。铁匠能迅速而高效地处理这些琐事，连原本以为报废了的装备也能修复。

units.source: {#1}This colorful Bounty Hunter has a pocket full of contracts on the most dangerous individuals. He knows how to get them from hiding and will pay handsomely for any bounty fulfilled.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}这位赏金猎人来历不凡，口袋里塞满了追捕穷凶极恶之徒的悬赏令。他知道怎样把目标从藏身处引出来，也会为每一笔完成的悬赏支付丰厚报酬。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 这位赏金猎人来历不凡，口袋里塞满了追捕穷凶极恶之徒的悬赏令。他知道怎样把目标从藏身处引出来，也会为每一笔完成的悬赏支付丰厚报酬。

units.source: {#1}The Brigand may be old and weak now, but at one point his name was feared across the land. In exchange for a hot meal he happily shares with you what he learns from his contacts about caravans on the road.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}这山贼如今虽已年老体衰，当年的名号却曾让四方闻风丧胆。只要给口热饭，他就乐意把从旧相识那里打听到的商队行踪都告诉你。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 这山贼如今虽已年老体衰，当年的名号却曾让四方闻风丧胆。只要给口热饭，他就乐意把从旧相识那里打听到的商队行踪都告诉你。

units.source: Makes you see the position of some caravans at all times and even if outside your sight radius
units.zh: 随时显示部分商队的位置，即使它们在你的视野之外

game_matches.translation: 随时显示部分商队的位置，即使它们在你的视野之外

units.source: {#1}The Cartographer is a man of culture and knowledge, but he also realizes that traveling in the company of well-armed mercenaries is one of the best ways to safely see the world and explore places that few visited before.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}制图师学识渊博，也很明白：想平安游历天下、探访人迹罕至之地，与一群全副武装的佣兵同行，是再好不过的办法之一。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 制图师学识渊博，也很明白：想平安游历天下、探访人迹罕至之地，与一群全副武装的佣兵同行，是再好不过的办法之一。

units.source: {#1}A good warm meal goes a long way towards healing body and mind. The Cook makes sure that no provisions go to waste, and provides the men with invigorating meals.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}一顿可口的热饭足以抚慰身心。厨师能让粮食物尽其用，为弟兄们备好恢复精力的饭菜。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 一顿可口的热饭足以抚慰身心。厨师能让粮食物尽其用，为弟兄们备好恢复精力的饭菜。

units.source: {#1}The Drill Sergeant was a mercenary once, but an injury ended his career prematurely. Now he drills discipline into your men and yells a lot to make sure that everyone learns from their mistakes.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}训练教官曾是一名佣兵，却因伤提前结束了战斗生涯。如今，他负责操练纪律，整日大声训斥，确保每个人都能从错误中长记性。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 训练教官曾是一名佣兵，却因伤提前结束了战斗生涯。如今，他负责操练纪律，整日大声训斥，确保每个人都能从错误中长记性。

units.source: Makes your men gain 20% more experience at level 1, with 2% less at each further level
units.zh: 弟兄们在1级时获得的经验提高20%，此后每升一级，该加成递减2%

game_matches.translation: 弟兄们在1级时获得的经验提高20%，此后每升一级，该加成递减2%

units.source: {#1}Having a quick Lookout with sharp eyes travel in advance of the company can prove invaluable in being aware of dangers and points of interests before others become aware of the company.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}让一个行动敏捷、目光锐利的瞭望员走在战团前头，往往大有裨益：在别人发现你们之前，他就能先发现危险与值得探访的地方。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 让一个行动敏捷、目光锐利的瞭望员走在战团前头，往往大有裨益：在别人发现你们之前，他就能先发现危险与值得探访的地方。

units.source: {#1}A good song and story play a large part in creating the reputation of a company. The Minstrel is a master of these crafts and will help to spread the word about your deeds to all ears - willing to hear them or not.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}一首好歌、一段好故事，都能让战团的名声传扬开来。吟游诗人深谙此道，会把你们的事迹唱进所有人的耳朵里——管他们愿不愿意听。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 一首好歌、一段好故事，都能让战团的名声传扬开来。吟游诗人深谙此道，会把你们的事迹唱进所有人的耳朵里——管他们愿不愿意听。

units.source: {#1}The Negotiator is home to noble courts and fancy halls, and not used to travelling with a band of sellswords with muddy boots, but he is an expert on traversing the mire of social relations and contract negotiations.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}谈判专家惯于出入贵族宫廷与华贵厅堂，可不习惯跟一帮满靴泥巴的佣兵四处奔波。不过，要说在复杂的人际关系和委托谈判中周旋，他可是行家。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 谈判专家惯于出入贵族宫廷与华贵厅堂，可不习惯跟一帮满靴泥巴的佣兵四处奔波。不过，要说在复杂的人际关系和委托谈判中周旋，他可是行家。

units.source: {#1}The Paymaster takes care of all the day-to-day financial and organizational aspects of running a mercenary company, like paying out wages.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}军饷官负责战团的日常财务与管理事务，例如发放薪酬。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 军饷官负责战团的日常财务与管理事务，例如发放薪酬。

units.source: Reduces the daily wage of each man by 15%
units.zh: 每名弟兄的日薪降低15%

game_matches.translation: 每名弟兄的日薪降低15%

units.source: {#1}With years of experience from traveling with caravans, the Quartermaster is able to squeeze and rotate any piece of gear, luggage or armor into the perfect spot to use space as efficiently as possible.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}军需官随商队走南闯北多年，深谙收纳之道。无论装备、行李还是护甲，他总能翻转挪腾、见缝插针，将每一寸空间都利用到极致。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 军需官随商队走南闯北多年，深谙收纳之道。无论装备、行李还是护甲，他总能翻转挪腾、见缝插针，将每一寸空间都利用到极致。

units.source: {#1}The Recruiter is a sleazy jawsmith that tricks desperate people into joining a mercenary company to escape their poor lives, only to find their demise. Quite useful for anyone running a mercenary company.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}招募官是个油嘴滑舌的无耻之徒，专骗走投无路的人加入战团，声称能让他们摆脱穷苦日子，结果只是把他们送上死路。对战团团长来说，这种人倒是相当有用。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 招募官是个油嘴滑舌的无耻之徒，专骗走投无路的人加入战团，声称能让他们摆脱穷苦日子，结果只是把他们送上死路。对战团团长来说，这种人倒是相当有用。

units.source: Makes you pay 10% less up front for hiring new men, and 50% less for tryouts
units.zh: 招募新人的雇用费用降低10%，考察费用降低50%

game_matches.translation: 招募新人的雇用费用降低10%，考察费用降低50%

units.source: Makes between 2 and 4 additional men available to recruit in every settlement
units.zh: 每处聚落额外增加2至4名可招募人员

game_matches.translation: 每处聚落额外增加2至4名可招募人员

units.source: {#1}Whether the son of one of your men or an urchin you took pity on, the Scavenger pulls his weight by collecting bits and pieces from every battlefield.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}拾荒者或许是某个弟兄的儿子，也可能是你一时心软收留的流浪儿。不管出身如何，他都会在战后四处捡拾，为战团出一份力。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 拾荒者或许是某个弟兄的儿子，也可能是你一时心软收留的流浪儿。不管出身如何，他都会在战后四处捡拾，为战团出一份力。

units.source: Recovers a part of all ammo you use during battle
units.zh: 回收战斗中消耗的部分弹药

game_matches.translation: 回收战斗中消耗的部分弹药

units.source: {#1}The Scout is an expert in finding mountain passes, navigating through treacherous swamps, and guiding anyone safely through the darkest of forests.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}寻找山间隘口、穿越险恶沼泽、带人平安走出幽暗密林，都是斥候的拿手本事。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 寻找山间隘口、穿越险恶沼泽、带人平安走出幽暗密林，都是斥候的拿手本事。

units.source: Makes the company travel 15% faster on any terrain
units.zh: 战团在所有地形上的行进速度提高15%

game_matches.translation: 战团在所有地形上的行进速度提高15%

units.source: {#1}The Surgeon is a walking tome of anatomical knowledge. A mercenary company seems the perfect place both to apply that knowledge in healing, but also to learn more about how the insides of men are made up.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}外科医生就是一本行走的人体解剖全书。战团似乎是他的理想去处：既能运用所学救死扶伤，又能进一步了解人体内部的构造。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 外科医生就是一本行走的人体解剖全书。战团似乎是他的理想去处：既能运用所学救死扶伤，又能进一步了解人体内部的构造。

units.source: {#1}Southern traders are renowned for their bartering skills. Lucky you that you could convince one such master of haggling to join your company. And at such a bargain!{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}
units.zh: {#1}南方商人以讨价还价的本事闻名。能说服这样一位砍价高手加入战团，你可真走运。何况价钱还这么便宜！{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}

game_matches.translation: 南方商人以讨价还价的本事闻名。能说服这样一位砍价高手加入战团，你可真走运。何况价钱还这么便宜！

units.source: {#1}The dark robes of an assassin. Fine chainmail is tied and woven tightly into the fabric.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}刺客的深色长袍，细密的锁甲被牢牢缝织进布料之中。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 刺客的深色长袍，细密的锁甲被牢牢缝织进布料之中。

units.source: {#1}A slightly worn-down, thin and light mail with additional metal plates grafted onto it.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}略有磨损的轻薄锁甲，外面又缀上金属甲片加固。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 略有磨损的轻薄锁甲，外面又缀上金属甲片加固。

units.source: {#1}A leather nomad armor stitched together from various hides and scraps.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}游牧民用各色兽皮与零碎皮料拼缝而成的皮甲。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 游牧民用各色兽皮与零碎皮料拼缝而成的皮甲。

units.source: {#1}A mail shirt fashioned from slightly thinner and lighter metal rings than those used in the north.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}编成这件锁甲衫的金属环，比北境所用的略薄，也更轻。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 编成这件锁甲衫的金属环，比北境所用的略薄，也更轻。

units.source: {#1}A long and heavy mail shirt with a thickly padded coat.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}厚重的长身锁甲，配有厚衬甲衣。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 厚重的长身锁甲，配有厚衬甲衣。

units.source: {#1}A heavy composite armor consisting of mail coat, padding and lamellar elements.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}由长身锁甲、厚实衬垫和札甲部件组合而成的重甲。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 由长身锁甲、厚实衬垫和札甲部件组合而成的重甲。

units.source: {#1}A lamellar shirt made from interlapping metal plates worn atop a mail shirt.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}在锁甲衫外加穿一件札甲衫，由层层交叠的金属甲片构成。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 在锁甲衫外加穿一件札甲衫，由层层交叠的金属甲片构成。

units.source: {#1}A leather harness commonly worn by pit fighters in arenas of the southern city states.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}南方城邦竞技场的斗士常穿的皮制护身带。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 南方城邦竞技场的斗士常穿的皮制护身带。

units.source: {#1}A double sash made from thick cloth that is worn across the body.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}用厚布制成，交叉披在身上的双层肩带。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 用厚布制成，交叉披在身上的双层肩带。

units.source: {#1}A double layered robe fashioned from thick cloth.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}用厚布制成的双层长袍。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 用厚布制成的双层长袍。

units.source: {#1}A nomad cloth robe worn to protect against both the heat and against cuts and bruises.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}游牧民穿的布袍，既能遮挡酷热，也能防止割伤与擦伤。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 游牧民穿的布袍，既能遮挡酷热，也能防止割伤与擦伤。

units.source: {#1}A thick cloth robe with added leather parts for increased protection.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}厚布长袍上加缀皮革，以加强防护。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 厚布长袍上加缀皮革，以加强防护。

units.source: {#1}A thick cloth vest padded with dense wool to protect against blunt hits.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}厚布背心内填紧实羊毛，以抵挡钝击。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 厚布背心内填紧实羊毛，以抵挡钝击。

units.source: {#1}A breastplate made of several layers of linen.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}以多层亚麻布制成的胸甲。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 以多层亚麻布制成的胸甲。

units.source: {#1}A light helmet typical of the southern desert regions.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}南方沙漠地区常见的轻型头盔。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 南方沙漠地区常见的轻型头盔。

units.source: {#1}A traditional southern head wrap suited for desert climate.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}适合沙漠气候的传统南方头巾。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 适合沙漠气候的传统南方头巾。

units.source: {#1}This metal helmet is wrapped in cloth to protect against the blazingly hot sun of the southern deserts.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这顶金属头盔外裹布料，以抵挡南方沙漠炙热的阳光。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 这顶金属头盔外裹布料，以抵挡南方沙漠炙热的阳光。

units.source: {#1}A metal skull cap with a fashionable spike worn atop a mail coif.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}顶部饰有时兴尖刺的金属颅盔，下衬锁甲头巾。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 顶部饰有时兴尖刺的金属颅盔，下衬锁甲头巾。

units.source: {#1}A southern metal helmet with a mail coif to protect the neck.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}南方式金属头盔，配有保护颈部的锁甲头巾。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 南方式金属头盔，配有保护颈部的锁甲头巾。

units.source: {#1}A full helmet crafted from overlapping long metal splints in the shape of a traditional southern head wrap.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}金属长条交叠拼成的全覆盔，外形仿照传统南方头巾。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 金属长条交叠拼成的全覆盔，外形仿照传统南方头巾。

units.source: Extinguishes existing tile effects like Fire or Miasma
units.zh: 清除区域内原有的火焰、瘴气等地格效果

game_matches.translation: 清除区域内原有的火焰、瘴气等地格效果

units.source: {#1}A small pot that quickly creates a dense smoke cloud when broken on the ground. Useful for covering movement.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一只小陶罐，落地破碎后会迅速释放浓烟，适合掩护移动。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一只小陶罐，落地破碎后会迅速释放浓烟，适合掩护移动。

units.source: {#1}A throwable pot filled with mysterious powders that react violently on impact to create a bright flash and loud bang. Will daze anyone close by.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}可投掷的陶罐，装着神秘粉末。撞击时会剧烈反应，发出强光和巨响，使附近的人陷入恍惚。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 可投掷的陶罐，装着神秘粉末。撞击时会剧烈反应，发出强光和巨响，使附近的人陷入恍惚。

units.source: {#1}A pot filled with highly flammable liquid that will set an area ablaze with fire when thrown.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}装满高度易燃液体的陶罐，投出后会让一片区域燃起大火。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 装满高度易燃液体的陶罐，投出后会让一片区域燃起大火。

units.source: {#1}A spear of southern design with an explosive charge that will spew fire over two tiles when ignited. The charge is only usable once per battle, but automatically refilled after battle.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一种南方设计的长矛，装有火药，点燃后能向前方两格喷出火焰。每场战斗只能喷射一次，战斗结束后会自动补充火药。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一种南方设计的长矛，装有火药，点燃后能向前方两格喷出火焰。每场战斗只能喷射一次，战斗结束后会自动补充火药。

units.source: {#1}An iron barrel with a long wooden handle. It fires shrapnel in a cone and can hit multiple targets with one shot. Can not be used while engaged in melee.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}铁制铳管装着长木柄，可向前方扇形范围喷射弹丸，一次击中多个目标。陷入近战时无法使用。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 铁制铳管装着长木柄，可向前方扇形范围喷射弹丸，一次击中多个目标。陷入近战时无法使用。

units.source: Furs taken from ferocious hyenas, cured and sewn together to be worn as a beast hunter's trophy around the neck. Donning the skin of a beast like this bolsters one's drive to action.
units.zh: 从凶猛鬣狗身上剥下的毛皮，经过鞣制、缝合，制成猎兽者披在颈肩处的战利品。披上这样的兽皮，让人更有行动的冲劲。

game_matches.translation: 从凶猛鬣狗身上剥下的毛皮，经过鞣制、缝合，制成猎兽者披在颈肩处的战利品。披上这样的兽皮，让人更有行动的冲劲。

units.source: {#1}Traded for with a mysterious traveler named Yuchi, the contents of this jug promises to be a magical drink that grants strength beyond imagining.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这壶饮料从名叫尤奇的神秘旅人处换来，据说是能赋予超乎想象之力量的魔饮。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 这壶饮料从名叫尤奇的神秘旅人处换来，据说是能赋予超乎想象之力量的魔饮。

units.source: {#1}An old and eerie looking tome with a fleshen cover. Its pages are filled with inscrutable writing and mysterious drawings that you can't begin to understand. The longer you look at the book, the more uneasy it makes you feel. Perhaps someone with more knowledge in ancient languages could make some sense of it.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一本古老而诡异的书，封皮仿佛由血肉制成。书页上满是无法辨认的文字和神秘图画，令人完全摸不着头脑。盯得越久，你就越感到不安。也许精通古代语言的人能读懂些什么。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一本古老而诡异的书，封皮仿佛由血肉制成。书页上满是无法辨认的文字和神秘图画，令人完全摸不着头脑。盯得越久，你就越感到不安。也许精通古代语言的人能读懂些什么。

units.source: {#1}An exquisitely crafted curved blade, notoriously used by assassins of the southern deserts. Particularly effective against targets already debilitated.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一柄精制弯刃匕首，因南方沙漠刺客的使用而恶名远扬。对已经陷入虚弱状态的目标格外有效。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 一柄精制弯刃匕首，因南方沙漠刺客的使用而恶名远扬。对已经陷入虚弱状态的目标格外有效。

units.source: {#1}A very large scimitar wielded with both hands. The curved blade cleaves right through any enemy, and the blade is surprisingly well balanced for its size.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}需要双手挥舞的巨型弯刀。弯曲的刀刃足以劈开挡路的敌人，刀身虽大，配重却出奇地均衡。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 需要双手挥舞的巨型弯刀。弯曲的刀刃足以劈开挡路的敌人，刀身虽大，配重却出奇地均衡。

units.source: You inquire as to why the dog, though. The man shrugs.
units.zh: 你问，可为什么要杀狗？那人耸肩。

game_matches.translation: 你问，可为什么要杀狗？那人耸肩。

units.source: "A scared dog makes for good target practice, I suppose."
units.zh: "受惊的狗，拿来练准头挺合适吧。"

game_matches.translation: "受惊的狗，拿来练准头挺合适吧。"

units.source: "I think I've seen one of these before. It's some sort of marking."
units.zh: "我好像见过这个。是一种标记。"

game_matches.translation: "我好像见过这个。是一种标记。"

units.source: "We need to be keeping an eye out for bored spinsters or something?"
units.zh: "所以，我们得小心无聊的老姑娘之类的？"

game_matches.translation: "所以，我们得小心无聊的老姑娘之类的？"

units.source: "Naw. This here is a goblin's fabrication. We're in their land now."
units.zh: "不，这是地精做的。我们进它们的地盘了。"

game_matches.translation: "不，这是地精做的。我们进它们的地盘了。"

units.source: "Step carefully, men, we're in goblin territory now."
units.zh: "小心走，弟兄们，我们进地精领地了。"

game_matches.translation: "小心走，弟兄们，我们进地精领地了。"

units.source: "This is goblin territory, men, and by the look of things they aren't far, either."
units.zh: "弟兄们，这是地精的地盘。看这模样，它们离得也不远。"

game_matches.translation: "弟兄们，这是地精的地盘。看这模样，它们离得也不远。"

units.source: "The goblins been gettin' more of their mounts."
units.zh: "地精又在弄坐骑了。"

game_matches.translation: "地精又在弄坐骑了。"

units.source: "They say the gobbos like the wild ones. They look for the freshest litters and only take the strongest."
units.zh: "听说，那帮小绿皮喜欢野生的。专找刚下崽的窝，只带走最壮的。"

game_matches.translation: "听说，那帮小绿皮喜欢野生的。专找刚下崽的窝，只带走最壮的。"

units.source: {#1}A crude weapon like a polemace can also be crafted with passion, skill and attention to detail, as this exemplar showcases impressively.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}即使是长柄钉锤这样粗犷的武器，也能倾注热忱、技艺与细致的打磨。眼前这柄，就是令人信服的明证。{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 即使是长柄钉锤这样粗犷的武器，也能倾注热忱、技艺与细致的打磨。眼前这柄，就是令人信服的明证。

units.source: "No. We were hired to fight, and fighting is what we want. We want battles, we want carnage, and we want the glory that comes with both."
units.zh: "不是。咱们受雇就是来打仗的，想干的也只有打仗。咱们要战斗，要杀戮，也要由此赢得的荣耀。"

game_matches.translation: "不是。咱们受雇就是来打仗的，想干的也只有打仗。咱们要战斗，要杀戮，也要由此赢得的荣耀。"

units.source: {#1}{#2}We'll see battle soon - you have my word!{/#2}{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 我保证，很快就有仗打！

units.source: "I understand. You are two battle-earnest men. You even remind me of myself though, with your skills, I can assure you that only I come out looking better by such a comparison. You are fine warriors, but is it not true that you will be paid the same regardless of this battle or that? Why be so worried about battles? They will come. I've not paid you to sit. I've paid you to be ready to stand."
units.zh: "我明白，你们两个都盼着打仗，甚至让我想起自己。不过，凭你们的本事，这一比，显得更强的肯定还是我。你们都是好战士，可打这一仗也好，那一仗也好，拿的钱难道不都一样？何必这么着急？仗总会有。我付钱，可不是让你们坐着，而是让你们随时准备站起来。"

game_matches.translation: "我明白，你们两个都盼着打仗，甚至让我想起自己。不过，凭你们的本事，这一比，显得更强的肯定还是我。你们都是好战士，可打这一仗也好，那一仗也好，拿的钱难道不都一样？何必这么着急？仗总会有。我付钱，可不是让你们坐着，而是让你们随时准备站起来。"

units.source: The men exchange a glance and then shrug and nod. They stand up in unison.
units.zh: 两人对视一眼，耸耸肩，又点点头，一同站起身。

game_matches.translation: 两人对视一眼，耸耸肩，又点点头，一同站起身。

units.source: "You are right, sir. And, when the time comes, we will be ready to stand and fight for you!"
units.zh: "你说得对，团长。等时候到了，我们一定站出来，为你而战！"

game_matches.translation: "你说得对，团长。等时候到了，我们一定站出来，为你而战！"

units.source: You try and explain to the men that, regardless of whether or not they're fighting, they are going to be getting paid. But money is not their primary concern. They truly wish to fight and you words have little effect on their rather earnest attitudes.
units.zh: 你试着解释，无论有没有仗打，军饷都照样发。可钱并不是弟兄们最在意的东西。他们确实渴望战斗，你这番话对那股热切几乎毫无作用。

game_matches.translation: 你试着解释，无论有没有仗打，军饷都照样发。可钱并不是弟兄们最在意的东西。他们确实渴望战斗，你这番话对那股热切几乎毫无作用。

units.source: You stand up and flatten your knuckles on the table.
units.zh: 你站起来，指节撑在桌上。

game_matches.translation: 你站起来，指节撑在桌上。

units.source: The men exchange a glance then quickly nod at you.
units.zh: 弟兄们互看一眼，赶紧点头。

game_matches.translation: 弟兄们互看一眼，赶紧点头。

units.source: "Then it is fighting you shall have! Fear not the sheathed sword, mercenaries. I will find you a good battle in due time!"
units.zh: "那就有仗给你们打！佣兵们，别怕刀剑闲在鞘里，我很快就给你们找场好仗！"

game_matches.translation: "那就有仗给你们打！佣兵们，别怕刀剑闲在鞘里，我很快就给你们找场好仗！"

units.source: Rising to their feet, the men shake your hand. They thank you as they leave the tent. Once they're gone, you go to your maps and look for the nearest ass to kick.
units.zh: 他们起身与你握手，道着谢离开帐篷。人一走，你便摊开地图，寻找最近那个欠收拾的家伙。

game_matches.translation: 他们起身与你握手，道着谢离开帐篷。人一走，你便摊开地图，寻找最近那个欠收拾的家伙。

units.source: The entire company - a motley little crew if you say so yourself - enters your tent all at once. A troupe of sellswords appearing in such a fashion is not the friendliest of sights and so for a split-second you think to reach for your sword. But then you notice that none of them have their weapons out nor do they carry the faces of men about to commit a murder. While they don't seem to be forming a mutiny to take your head, you keep the thought in mind nonetheless.
units.zh: 整个战团的人一齐挤进你的帐篷——说实话，也就是这么一小撮杂牌人马。一群佣兵如此登门，怎么看都不像是好事，有那么一瞬间，你甚至想伸手拔剑。但随即你注意到，没人亮出武器，脸上也没有即将动手杀人的神情。看起来，他们不是来哗变砍你脑袋的，不过你仍暗自留了个心眼。

game_matches.translation: 整个战团的人一齐挤进你的帐篷——说实话，也就是这么一小撮杂牌人马。一群佣兵如此登门，怎么看都不像是好事，有那么一瞬间，你甚至想伸手拔剑。但随即你注意到，没人亮出武器，脸上也没有即将动手杀人的神情。看起来，他们不是来哗变砍你脑袋的，不过你仍暗自留了个心眼。

units.source: You are only further relieved when they don't immediately start talking, instead waiting for your words to come first. This is a show of respect, and so the thought of reaching for your sword grows more distant. Crossing your arms over the table, you ask them what is on their minds.
units.zh: 他们没有立刻开口，而是等着你先说话，这又让你松了一口气。这是尊重的表现，你拔剑的念头也越发淡了。你把双臂交叠在桌上，问他们有什么心事。

game_matches.translation: 他们没有立刻开口，而是等着你先说话，这又让你松了一口气。这是尊重的表现，你拔剑的念头也越发淡了。你把双臂交叠在桌上，问他们有什么心事。

units.source: They explain that the company is too thin. Everywhere they go there is danger and the men are now concerned that every new battle shall be their last. Finally, they state their wants outright: if they are going to survive, they're going to need more brothers by their side.
units.zh: 弟兄们解释，战团的人手太少了。无论走到哪里都危机四伏，大家越来越担心，下一场战斗就是自己的最后一战。最终，他们直截了当地说出了要求：要想活下去，就得有更多弟兄并肩作战。

game_matches.translation: 弟兄们解释，战团的人手太少了。无论走到哪里都危机四伏，大家越来越担心，下一场战斗就是自己的最后一战。最终，他们直截了当地说出了要求：要想活下去，就得有更多弟兄并肩作战。

units.source: {#1}{#2}We'll reinforce the company with new men soon - you have my word.{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}{#2}我保证，很快就招新人来补充战团。{/#2}{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 我保证，很快就招新人来补充战团。

units.source: {#1}{#2}There is no need to hire men, we're doing fine this way.{/#2}{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 用不着再招人，这样就挺好。

units.source: You immediately stand up and rap the table with your knuckles.
units.zh: 你立刻起身，用指节敲了敲桌子。

game_matches.translation: 你立刻起身，用指节敲了敲桌子。

units.source: "The best of minds truly must think alike for I have already set aside some crowns for hiring new brothers!"
units.zh: "果然英雄所见略同，我已经留出一笔克朗，准备招募新弟兄了！"

game_matches.translation: "果然英雄所见略同，我已经留出一笔克朗，准备招募新弟兄了！"

units.source: The anxious, almost sad faces on the men slowly begin to change. They smile and nod and say things like 'alright' and 'that's good.' When they turn to leave, you notice they've got daggers sheathed behind their backs.
units.zh: 众人忧虑得近乎悲伤的表情渐渐变了，开始微笑、点头，说着“那就好”“不错”。他们转身离开时，你注意到，每个人背后都藏着一把带鞘的匕首。

game_matches.translation: 众人忧虑得近乎悲伤的表情渐渐变了，开始微笑、点头，说着“那就好”“不错”。他们转身离开时，你注意到，每个人背后都藏着一把带鞘的匕首。

units.source: "You are some of the finest soldiers I've ever seen. I don't think you have anything to fear. Our enemies fear for their own lives when they see you!"
units.zh: "你们是我见过最出色的战士。我不觉得有什么好怕的。敌人见到你们，才该担心自己的小命！"

game_matches.translation: "你们是我见过最出色的战士。我不觉得有什么好怕的。敌人见到你们，才该担心自己的小命！"

units.source: But your words don't go over well. One man leans forward with an arm behind his back, but another man claps a hand on his shoulder and quickly shakes his head. He only looks at you and says.
units.zh: 可这番话并没有起到好作用。一人探身向前，手藏在背后；另一人却一把按住他的肩，迅速摇头。那人只是看着你，说道。

game_matches.translation: 可这番话并没有起到好作用。一人探身向前，手藏在背后；另一人却一把按住他的肩，迅速摇头。那人只是看着你，说道。

units.source: "This is most concerning news, sir, but we shall carry on."
units.zh: "这回答实在让人忧心，团长。不过，我们会继续干下去。"

game_matches.translation: "这回答实在让人忧心，团长。不过，我们会继续干下去。"

units.source: When they turn to leave, you notice the clasp on one man's sheathed dagger has been unlatched.
units.zh: 两人转身离开时，你注意到，其中一人腰间匕首的鞘扣已经解开。

game_matches.translation: 两人转身离开时，你注意到，其中一人腰间匕首的鞘扣已经解开。

units.source: Fanning your arms out and pressing forth a smile that couldn't sell water to a thirsty man, you lie.
units.zh: 你摊开双臂，挤出一个连渴鬼都骗不到水钱的笑，撒了个谎。

game_matches.translation: 你摊开双臂，挤出一个连渴鬼都骗不到水钱的笑，撒了个谎。

units.source: "We've simply not the coffers to take on more men."
units.zh: "账上实在没有余钱再招人。"

game_matches.translation: "账上实在没有余钱再招人。"

units.source: The men don't take it well. One immediately turns around and exits the tent, a wake of curses and swears in the wake of his leaving. Another brother momentarily reaches behind his back. You glance at your sword again. He sees you doing this, and then puts his hands back where you can see them. Finally, he nods.
units.zh: 弟兄们很不买账。一个人立刻转身出帐，一路咒骂不止；另一个人的手短暂地伸向背后。你又瞥了眼自己的剑。他看见了，便把双手放回你看得见的地方，最后点头。

game_matches.translation: 弟兄们很不买账。一个人立刻转身出帐，一路咒骂不止；另一个人的手短暂地伸向背后。你又瞥了眼自己的剑。他看见了，便把双手放回你看得见的地方，最后点头。

units.source: When you let the men know that you've not enough crowns on hand to hire more men, they nod.
units.zh: 你告诉弟兄们，手头的克朗不够再雇人，他们点点头。

game_matches.translation: 你告诉弟兄们，手头的克朗不够再雇人，他们点点头。

units.source: "We thought you might say that. So here's our suggestion, and we don't say this lightly, but each of us will give you part of what we saved up for retirement so that you may hire others. And you'll pay us back with our wages."
units.zh: "猜到你会这么说。所以我们有个提议，也不是随口讲讲：大家从养老钱里各拿出一部分给你，让你招些新人。之后，再随军饷慢慢还给我们。"

game_matches.translation: "猜到你会这么说。所以我们有个提议，也不是随口讲讲：大家从养老钱里各拿出一部分给你，让你招些新人。之后，再随军饷慢慢还给我们。"

units.source: You quickly glance up, the suggestion seemingly coming out of nowhere.
units.zh: 你猛地抬头，这提议实在出乎意料。

game_matches.translation: 你猛地抬头，这提议实在出乎意料。

units.source: {#1}{#2}This is the way we shall do it then - thank you all for your sacrifice.{/#2}{/#1}

game_matches.translation: 那就这么办，多谢大家的牺牲。

units.source: You let the men know that you've not the crowns to take on more sellswords. They collectively sigh and nod.
units.zh: 你告诉弟兄们，没钱再招更多佣兵。他们一同叹气，点了点头。

game_matches.translation: 你告诉弟兄们，没钱再招更多佣兵。他们一同叹气，点了点头。

units.source: "That's alright, sir. T'was only a suggestion. As always, we shall march on your orders."
units.zh: "没事，团长，只是个提议。和往常一样，我们听你的命令。"

game_matches.translation: "没事，团长，只是个提议。和往常一样，我们听你的命令。"

units.source: The men turn and leave, a little slouched over and quieter than before.
units.zh: 他们转身离开，背比刚才更弯，话也更少了。
